About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product
recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Job Description Sales Head (Mizoram)
Position: Sales Head
Location: Mizoram
Experience: 5+ Years
Salary: 5–50 LPA, based on experience, market exposure, and relevant industry expertise
Profile: Target-Based Sales
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Head to lead and expand our sales operations in Mizoram. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in the sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
The candidate should have excellent knowledge of the Mizoram market, strong dealer and distributor networks, and the ability to achieve sales targets through effective market development and channel management.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Lead and manage sales activities across the Mizoram market.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.
Identify and appoint new dealers and distributors to expand market presence.
Manage and strengthen existing dealer and distributor networks.
Regularly visit the market to understand market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities, and business opportunities.
Drive sales of Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler/Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Generate new business opportunities and expand the company's customer base.
Negotiate with dealers, distributors, and customers regarding pricing, orders, schemes, and commercial terms.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions wherever required.
Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, product availability, dispatches, payments, and customer support.
Prepare regular sales reports, market updates, and sales forecasts for management.
Monitor competitor pricing, products, schemes, and market activities.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments from dealers and distributors.
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or Channel Sales.
Relevant experience in Lithium Inverter Batteries, Inverters, Batteries, Two-Wheeler Batteries, Three-Wheeler Batteries, and Solar Batteries.
Strong experience in dealer and distributor handling.
Proven track record of achieving target-based sales.
Strong understanding of the Mizoram market.
Required Skills
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Strong knowledge of market development and channel management.
Ability to effectively deal with dealers, distributors, retailers, and customers.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Good understanding of sales targets, business development, and revenue generation.
Strong networking and relationship-management abilities.
Willingness to travel extensively across the market.
Ability to work in a highly target-oriented environment.
Compensation
5 LPA to 50 LPA, depending on experience, market exposure, existing dealer/distributor network, industry knowledge, and sales performance.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates who have a strong existing network of dealers and distributors in Mizoram and proven experience in Lithium Batteries, Inverters, Solar Batteries, Two-Wheeler/Three-Wheeler Batteries, or related products will be highly preferred.

Description:
No of opening/s: 4 (Four); Male/Female.
Reports to: HEAD COACH, of respective teams.
Teams training base: Various locations in India.
Type of Contract: Contract.
Salary and perks: Commensurate with qualifications and experience AIFF norms.

Job Description.
The Video Analyst will contribute to the development of the team by through the use of video and related technology as per the directions of the Head Coach.
The team schedules could be at various locations in India and overseas and the incumbent will be expected to travel and stay with the team as per the programme.
Main Responsibilities.
Capture video footage of training sessions and matches.
Edit and present footage to the coach as per the latters requirements.
Conduct analysis on opposition by using video applications or any available footage.
Work in concert with the team staff that may include goalkeeping coach, fitness trainer, physio, team manager, analyst others, keeping the goal of sustaining the teams development as top priority.
Maintain archives of the video analysis.
Provide analysis as and when required by AIFF committees, scouting department, etc Make efficient use of the available resources.
Maintain exemplary personal behaviour to maintain and enhance the status of the Indian National team.
Participate in/contribute to any seminars/teaching programmes/conferences/etc organised by the key stakeholders viz.
, All India Football Federation /or the Sports Authority of India in relation to the incumbents domain of expertise.
Key Performance Indicators.
Head Coach assessment.
Detailed KPI to be established and reviewed in consultation with Head Coach.
Candidate Profile.
At least 3 years of experience as video analyst in a football programme.
Past experience in NT projects will be an advantage.
Keen interest in the nuance of the game and player behaviour.
Adept at using technology and video analysis platforms.
A satisfactory level of ability in using applications like Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
Able to devise ways to present complex matters in simpler ways for youth players from varied cultures to understand.
Good communicator in Hindi and English.
Other Indian languages will be a plus.
Graduate in any discipline from a Government of India recognised institution or university.
Willing to drive own development through recognised courses and licences in his field.
Able to visualise and pursue ambitious goals that may disrupt the prevailing scenario and take Indian football to great heights.
Pleasing personality with professional attitude; willing and able to strike rapport with youth and the other staff from different cultures in an environment with language limitations.
Candidates should be willing to produce documents, as asked for, for background checks/due diligence.
The documents will include, among others, original certificates in support of date of birth, educational professional qualifications, experience certificates, etc along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within a week after the application deadline.
Shortlisted candidates should be ready to present themselves for interview/s in person within a week or earlier.
In certain unavoidable circumstances, the interview/s could be conducted through a webcam over the internet.
Related travel lodging/boarding expenses will have to be borne by the candidate.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/s.
The selected candidate will be expected to join the team any time after selection.
As the job may involve regular overseas travel, a candidate is expected to hold a valid passport and should be able to produce documents, if asked for, to prove his/her worthiness to travel.

Description:
We are seeking an experienced Optometrist to join our team at Lenskat. As an Optometrist, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive eye and vision care to patients of all ages.
Responsibilities
Conduct eye examinations and vision tests to determine visual acuity and prescribe corrective lenses.
Diagnose and treat eye diseases and conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, and macular degeneration.
Fit and adjust eyeglasses and contact lenses for patients.
Provide pre- and post-operative care for patients undergoing eye surgery.
Educate patients on proper eye care and maintenance.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records.
Requirements
Minimum of 0-15 years of experience as an Optometrist.
Bachelor's degree in Optometry or relevant field.
Corporate certified ophthalmic assistant or relevant skillsets such as refractometry, ocular motility, and visual field testing.
Strong knowledge of eye anatomy, optics, and diseases.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
Current state Optometry license.

Job Description:
Objective: The purpose of the role is to execute all channel related activities for the designated area through vendor which includes eating and drinking, modern trade, mom and pop retailers, grocery and non traditional channels or point of sale and vendor management
Title: Team Leader Channel
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Indore, Pune
Job Responsibilities:
Channel Programs
1. Execution of unit specific initiatives in E&D, Grocery, and Convenience channel as per plan shared
2. Ensure outlet activation execution as per RED standards
3. Ensure support development and implementation of unit activation plans, using approved national/regional channel standards.
4. Planning of standard approved activation elements & other marketing collaterals
5. Execution and portfolio management as per the plan shared
Across depots & distributors
1. Execution of local initiatives
2. Tracking of systems and evaluation process
3. Local Initiatives to scale up the national/regional program
Analysis and Reporting
1. Activation as per RED / DEEP RED to do list.
2. Identify gaps & growth opportunities in various channels as per PITA model
3. Tracking of competition activities
4. Ensure activation in market through analysis RSA data
Supervises: None
Direct Reports: None
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Channel Manager/Channel Manager
Key Customers:
Internal Customers: Sales Team at the Unit, Finance, RTM
External Customers: Vendors, Suppliers, Distributors, Key Accounts, Agencies, Customers
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation/M.B.A.
Experience: 4-8 Years
Functional Skills:
Customer Management (a)-Competent
Financial Knowledge / Application and Appreciation (a)- Working Knowledge
Market Execution (a)-Competent
Planning and Analytics (b)-Working Knowledge
Sales Management (b)-Working Knowledge
Travel: Above 75%

Description:
Role Overview:
Lead all engineering, technical maintenance, HSE, and AMC operations at The Client's Powai facility, ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing facility environment. Oversee critical building systems, statutory compliance, vendor management, and operational excellence as per Master Service Agreement requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage all technical operations, maintenance, and uptime for site systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, lifts, and water systems
Regularly review asset health, preventive maintenance schedules, system performance, and identify improvement opportunities
Plan and execute all technical preparations for meetings, conferences, client visits, and special events
Perform daily check-ins and inspections around facility to ensure high technical and safety standards
Ensure 100% compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements including labour, fire, EHS, DG, lifts, FSSAI, and environmental laws
Maintain audit-ready documentation, statutory registers, and ensure timely submissions of compliance reports
Develop and enforce SOPs for technical operations, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols
Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) preparedness, conduct drills, and coordinate emergency response procedures
Coordinate and manage AMC vendor partners: validate contract compliance, oversee maintenance delivery, and schedule preventive and corrective work
Review vendor service reports, close technical findings, and ensure quality standards are met
Manage contractors and service providers: qualification checks, safety plan reviews, EHS document control, and ongoing performance monitoring
Conduct regular technical, safety, and risk audits; investigate incidents and drive corrective action closure
Provide staff HSE and safety training; promote safety culture across facility operations
Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time
Maintain operational and technical records as per contract and regulatory requirements
Drive sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, technology adoption, and continuous service improvements
Collaborate with Facility Manager, site leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders on priorities, procurement, and budget management
Identify and implement best practices to help facility systems perform at optimal levels
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil) or related technical discipline
5-7 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering operations, or HSE leadership roles
Strong knowledge of building systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, and critical infrastructure
Understanding of statutory compliance requirements including fire safety, EHS regulations, and environmental laws
Experience with AMC/vendor management, contract compliance, and service delivery oversight
Proficiency in audit management, documentation, and regulatory reporting
Working knowledge of digital FM tools, CMMS, and technical reporting systems
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Team leadership skills with capability to coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors
Tertiary qualifications in building management, facility management, or business management preferred
Certifications in safety, fire safety, or facility management are advantageous

Description:
Job Summary
Location: Bhopal
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time Helpline Engineer in Bhopal were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your fault-finding and technical expertise in a dynamic and innovative field. Youll work alongside supportive and collaborative teammates.
You'll play a critical role in ensuring the service delivery, availability, and reliability of our fleets and infrastructure equipment. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (such as Production Managers, Test Members, Fleet Control, and Engineering Teams), provide technical support to autonomous teams, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our systems and processes.
Youll specifically take care of troubleshooting and fault diagnosis, but also support training and planning activities to enhance team capabilities.
Well look to you for:
Providing technical support and fault-finding expertise to maintenance and warranty teams
Analyzing system event data to identify failure modes and compiling test/rectification reports
Supporting infrastructure maintenance and intervention at other sites when required
Collaborating with Fleet Control, Engineering, and Reliability Teams to identify and resolve technical issues
Assisting in pre-work planning for shifts and contributing to the development of accurate planning boards
Supporting knowledge transfer and training within autonomous teams
Ensuring adherence to safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety and compliance
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
An Engineering qualification such as a Higher National Certificate (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering
Practical experience and sound knowledge of rolling stock and infrastructure equipment
Technical expertise in fault finding and implementing repairs
Competence in the use of diagnostic tools and software
Proficiency in the local language
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency with IT tools, including office packages, email, and intranet
A logical, organized approach to problem-solving and a willingness to share suggestions for improvement

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations

Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.
Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment, ensuring that merchandise is properly displayed and priced.
Perform regular inventory checks, restock shelves, and assist with merchandise deliveries as needed.
Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner, escalating to management as necessary.
Stay updated on product offerings, promotions, and company policies to provide accurate information to customers.
Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets, meet customer service goals, and ensure the overall success of the store.

Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.
Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

- Proficiency in customer analytics tools and techniques.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.

Tools Required:
- Familiarity with CRM software and customer analytics platforms.
- Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, or other relevant software.
- Experience with reporting and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
- Knowledge of marketing automation tools will be a plus.

Candidates with a background in data analytics, customer experience, or marketing will be preferred for this position. Join Axis Max Life Insurance and contribute to building lasting customer relationships through innovative loyalty programs.

Essential

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI Architect to design and lead the development of scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Python, and AI solution architecture, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design and architect end-to-end AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions.
Define AI architecture, technology strategy, frameworks, and implementation standards.
Develop and implement LLM-based applications, AI agents, RAG solutions, and intelligent automation.
Design scalable AI platforms and solutions using cloud technologies.
Work closely with business, data, engineering, and product teams to identify AI use cases.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI/ML engineering teams.
Evaluate and recommend AI models, frameworks, tools, and technologies.
Design solutions integrating LLMs, APIs, vector databases, knowledge bases, and enterprise systems.
Ensure AI solutions meet requirements related to security, scalability, performance, governance, and responsible AI.
Stay updated with the latest developments in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, NLP, Machine Learning, and AI platforms.
Required Skills
12+ years of overall IT experience.
4+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML and Generative AI.
Strong experience in Agentic AI and AI solution architecture.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Experience with Generative AI / LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, and NLP.
Strong understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
Experience with cloud AI services such as AWS / Azure / GCP.
Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, APIs, and AI frameworks.
Strong understanding of software architecture, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native application design.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Good to Have
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI frameworks.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
Knowledge of MLOps / LLMOps and AI governance.
Experience implementing enterprise-scale AI solutions.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps.
Exposure to AI security, responsible AI, and model evaluation.
Preferred Candidate
Candidates with strong hands-on experience in AI Architecture + Generative AI + Agentic AI + Python, who can lead enterprise AI transformation initiatives, are preferred.
Immediate joiners are highly preferred.

Direct Reportees: Store Managers

Description: 

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. Sales Leadership:

- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into

Business plans.

- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.

- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent

- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication

- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for

- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from

a diverse team.

- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level

- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.

- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Opportunity:

Dainik Bhaskar is replacing a 20-year-old SAP system with modern enterprise software built from scratch: Master Database Management, Order Management System, and a field Sales Customer Relationship Manager serving 1,000+ sales executives across 61 cities. The platform layer is the hardest part: multi-level approval chains, workflow configuration, legacy data migration, and data models that took two decades to evolve. We need someone who thinks in systems, not features.
This is NOT a consumer PM role.
You will spend more time mapping approval hierarchies and documenting edge cases than designing interfaces. If platform architecture and workflow configuration interest you - this is the role. If you want growth hacking or B2C work, this is not it.

What You'll Own:

Order Management System (OMS)
End-to-end ad booking lifecycle - initiation through moderation, scheduling, and completion across all order segments. Built for B2B Agencies, B2C Customer Platform, and Internal Users.
Agency features - dashboards, client manager, reports for billing statements, credit note statements, payment advice logs, outstanding registers
Integration design - OMS to MDM, ad scheduling systems, and finance and billing
Master Data Management (MDM)
Sales User Hierarchy System - 1,000+ sales executives, dual reporting structures, role-based access, approval chain configuration
Business Partner Management System - agency, direct client, and government onboarding with different validation rules
Workflow Configuration Engine - multi-level approvals, with proxy and delegation logic, exception scenario handling
Rate and Scheme Configuration - rate card structure, discount governance, pricing logic enforcement
Platform Integrity
Data migration planning - legacy SAP to new schema, migration rules and validation checks
Edge case documentation - every 'what if' resolved before development, not after
UAT design and facilitation - 20-30 test cases per module with domain expert users


Must-Have Skills:
5-10 years in product management or business analysis, with at least 3 years on enterprise B2B systems
Platform-level thinking - data models, workflow engines, approval hierarchies, integration design
Enterprise system experience - ERP, CRM, OMS, or equivalent. You understand how these are structured and why
Documentation depth - PRDs a developer can build from without clarifying questions
Edge case instinct - you ask 'what happens when...' and do not stop until you have an answer
Stakeholder management in legacy organisations - you can earn trust with 50-year-old domain experts independently
SQL or Excel proficiency - data validation, migration checks, and reporting without engineering support

Strong Advantage
SAP or legacy system migration experience
Ad sales, media, or publishing domain knowledge
Workflow configuration tool experience - designed or configured approval chains in any enterprise system
B2B billing, invoicing, or financial operations systems

Red Flags - You Won't Enjoy This If...
Consumer apps or growth hacking is what you want to work on.
Detailed documentation - edge cases, validation rules, data models - bores you.
You get frustrated with slow-moving stakeholders or push back on change.
You want remote or hybrid flexibility - this primarily on-site in Bhopal,

Success in This Role Looks Like
Timeline

3 months:
3-4 PRDs for MDM or OMS modules shipped by developers without major rework.
10+ stakeholder sessions facilitated independently.
One complete approval workflow documented end-to-end - all paths, all edge cases, all fallbacks.
6 months:
2-3 modules owned end-to-end from BRD through UAT through launch.
Data migration planning led for at least one legacy data set.
Stakeholder walkthroughs run independently without Product Lead in the room.
12 months:
Platform components shipped impacting 500+ users and core revenue operations.
Go-to person for data models, workflow rules, and integration contracts.
Ready to lead a product vertical or step into a Senior PM role.

Why Join Dainik Bhaskar
Own the platform layer of a transformation running the revenue operations of India's largest Hindi newspaper group.
Work on genuinely hard problems - approval hierarchies, legacy data migration, workflow configuration at scale.
Direct leadership visibility - founders and promoters are involved in the transformation.
Build something that lasts - the operational backbone of a 70-year-old business, not a feature experiment.

About the Role
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive who has good hands-on experience in e-commerce and understands how digital marketing contributes to sales and customer growth.
The person will mainly handle SEO, social media, content marketing, email marketing, customer research, competitor research, and marketing analytics.
You should be comfortable working with different teams, understanding what customers are looking for, and turning those insights into useful marketing campaigns and content.
You will also work closely with the Performance Marketing team to make sure our organic and paid marketing activities are working together.

What You Will Be Doing
1. E-commerce Marketing
Plan and execute digital marketing activities for our e-commerce business.
Understand our products, customers, competitors, offers, and USPs.
Help plan campaigns around new products, offers, festivals, and important business events.
Look for new ways to increase brand visibility, customer engagement, traffic, and sales.
Work with the performance marketing team and creative team on campaign planning.
Keep track of what is working and what needs to be improved.
2. SEO
Do keyword research for products, categories, and relevant topics.
Find keywords that potential customers are actually searching for.
Work on on-page SEO for product and category pages.
Optimize titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, and images.
Track rankings, organic traffic, clicks, impressions, and CTR.
Use Google Search Console and SEO tools to find new opportunities.
Check competitors and understand what they are doing differently.
Work with the content team to create SEO-focused content.
Identify products and categories where we have an opportunity to grow organically.
3. Content Marketing
Plan content around our products and target customers.
Come up with content ideas based on customer questions, problems, and interests.
Work on ideas for:
Product education
Product benefits
FAQs
Product comparisons
Customer reviews
Testimonials
UGC
How-to content
Problem/solution content
Prepare and manage the monthly content calendar.
Coordinate with designers, video editors, creators, and copywriters.
Look at content performance and understand what type of content gets better response.
Turn customer questions and objections into content ideas.
4. Social Media
Manage the brand's organic social media presence.
Plan and publish content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn, depending on the brand's requirements.
Plan Reels, posts, carousels, stories, and other relevant formats.
Keep up with relevant trends and find ways to use them for the brand.
Coordinate with the creative team for content production.
Monitor reach, engagement, saves, shares, views, profile visits, and website clicks.
Identify content that performs well and find ways to build on it.
Keep an eye on competitors and their social media activity.
The goal isn't simply to increase followers. We want content that gets people interested in the brand and products.
5. Email & Customer Retention
Plan and execute email marketing campaigns.
Maintain and segment customer lists.
Create campaigns for:
New customers
Existing customers
Repeat customers
Abandoned carts
Product education
Cross-sell and upsell
Promotions
Customer reactivation
Track email performance including open rate, CTR, conversions, revenue, and unsubscribes.
Look for opportunities to increase repeat purchases and customer engagement.
Experience with WhatsApp marketing or CRM automation will be an advantage.
6. Customer & Competitor Research
Understand what customers like, dislike, and expect from the brand.
Go through customer reviews, comments, questions, and feedback.
Identify common customer doubts and objections.
Research competitors' products, pricing, offers, content, and positioning.
Keep track of market trends and new opportunities.
Share useful customer and competitor insights with the marketing team.

You should be comfortable working with numbers and understanding what they mean.
Track things such as:
Website & Organic
Organic traffic
Search clicks
Impressions
CTR
Keyword rankings
Product/category performance
Social Media
Reach

Revenue
Unsubscribe rate
Prepare weekly and monthly reports and, more importantly, explain:
What happened Why it happened What we should do next
We don't need someone who simply sends a spreadsheet full of numbers.
8. Working With the Performance Marketing Team
You will work closely with the person managing Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Your responsibilities will include:
Share customer insights and content ideas with the performance marketing team.
Identify organic content that could potentially work as paid-ad creative.
Share customer objections, FAQs, and product feedback.
Coordinate messaging for product launches and promotional campaigns.
Share competitor and market insights.
Work together on campaign ideas and marketing communication.
Help maintain consistency between organic content and paid advertising.
Senior Performance Marketing Specialist Meta Ads
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: In-Office

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Specialist with strong hands-on experience in Meta Ads and e-commerce marketing.
This person will be responsible for managing the paid acquisition side of the business, with Meta Ads as the primary channel. You will be expected to take ownership of campaign strategy, execution, optimization, scaling, reporting, and overall paid-media performance.
We are looking for someone who understands that good performance marketing is not just about getting a low CPC or high CTR. The focus should be on generating profitable sales, acquiring the right customers, and finding sustainable ways to scale the business.
The role will work closely with the Digital Marketing, Creative, Content, and Management teams.

Key Responsibilities
1. Own Meta Ads From Strategy to Execution
Take complete ownership of the brand's Meta advertising account and paid-media strategy.
Plan campaigns according to business goals, product margins, customer acquisition targets, and available budget.
Build and manage campaigns for e-commerce sales, lead generation, remarketing, and other relevant objectives.
Decide how the account should be structured based on the product, audience, funnel, and campaign objective.
Manage campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
Review account performance regularly and make decisions on what to scale, maintain, restructure, test, or stop.
Keep the account organized and maintain clear naming, campaign structures, audiences, creatives, and reporting.

2. Audience & Customer Strategy
Develop audience strategies for both new customer acquisition and retargeting.
Work with broad targeting, Custom Audiences, Lookalikes, website visitors, customer lists, purchasers, product viewers, video viewers, and social engagers where relevant.
Use first-party customer data to improve targeting and customer acquisition.
Understand the difference between high-intent and low-intent audiences.
Monitor audience saturation, frequency, and changes in audience quality.
Adjust targeting based on actual campaign and customer data rather than relying on assumptions.

3. Creative Strategy
At a senior level, the candidate should be able to tell the creative team what needs to be tested and why.
Develop creative testing plans based on product, customer behavior, and campaign performance.
Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, benefits, objections, and messaging opportunities.
Work with designers, video editors, UGC creators, and content teams to produce new ad creatives.
Test different formats such as UGC, Reels, product demonstrations, testimonials, static ads, and other suitable formats.
Analyze creative performance and identify fatigue before it significantly affects campaign results.
Turn winning creative insights into new variations rather than repeatedly using the same ad.
Maintain a consistent pipeline of new creative ideas and tests.

4. Performance Analysis & Optimization
The candidate should be able to look at an account and understand where the problem actually is.
Monitor and analyze metrics including:
CPM | CTR | CPC | Frequency | Landing Page Views | Add to Cart | Checkout | Purchases | CPA | CAC | ROAS | Revenue | AOV
The candidate should be able to investigate situations such as:
CPM increasing unexpectedly.
CTR falling while CPM remains stable.
Good CTR but poor conversion rate.
Good conversion rate but poor ROAS.
Rising CPA despite stable traffic.
Strong ROAS but insufficient purchase volume.
A previously successful creative suddenly declining.
Retargeting becoming expensive because of audience saturation.
Optimization decisions should be based on data, customer behavior, economics, and the overall funnel, not on one metric in isolation.

5. Budget Management & Scaling
Manage daily, weekly, and monthly advertising budgets.
Decide where budget should be increased, reduced, or reallocated.
Build controlled scaling plans for winning campaigns, products, audiences, and creatives.
Understand the difference between scaling spend and scaling profitable revenue.
Monitor CAC, CPA, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, and contribution margin where data is available.
Prepare budget forecasts and expected performance scenarios.
Identify when performance is limited by budget, audience size, creative volume, offer, or conversion rate.
Make scaling decisions without sacrificing the overall economics of the business.

6. Tracking, Measurement & Attribution
Strong tracking knowledge is required for this role.
Manage and troubleshoot Meta Pixel/Dataset and Events Manager.
Understand events such as View Content, Add to Cart, Initiate Checkout, Purchase, and Lead.
Work with Conversions API (CAPI) and understand the role of server-side event tracking.
Check whether important events are being received correctly and consistently.
Work with developers or technical teams when tracking issues need to be resolved.
Investigate differences between Meta, GA4, Shopify, CRM, and backend data.
Understand that platform-reported conversions and revenue are not always directly comparable.
Use reliable first-party and business data when making major budget decisions.
Work with GA4 and Google Tag Manager where required.

7. E-commerce Funnel & Conversion Optimization
Meta Ads cannot be evaluated separately from what happens after the click.
Work with the relevant teams to understand:
Ad Product/Landing Page Add to Cart Checkout Purchase
Identify potential problems with:
Product positioning
Offer and pricing
Landing-page messaging
Product information
Reviews and trust signals
CTA
Checkout experience
Mobile experience
Use available data from GA4, Shopify, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, and advertising platforms to support recommendations.
The Performance Marketing Specialist should be able to identify whether poor performance is actually an ad problem or a post-click conversion problem.

8. Testing & Experimentation
Maintain a structured testing process rather than making random changes to campaigns.
Tests may include:
Creative
New hooks
New angles
UGC
Testimonials
Product demonstrations
Offers
Different formats

Headlines

Page messaging
Every meaningful test should have a clear:
Hypothesis Test Result Learning Next Action

Google Ads Working Knowledge
Meta Ads will be the main area of responsibility, but the candidate should have enough Google Ads knowledge to understand the overall paid-acquisition picture.
The candidate should be comfortable with:
Google Search campaigns
Performance Max
Shopping campaigns
Basic Display/YouTube campaign concepts

What happened?

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs. plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. Sales Leadership:

- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.
