Job Summary
SAP ALM We are looking for an experienced SAP Application Lifecycle Management Consultant to manage and improve SAP change, release, deployment and implementation processes across SAP Solution Manager ChaRM, Focused Build and SAP Cloud ALM. The role will be responsible for supporting the current ALM landscape while driving the transition from Solution Manager-based processes to SAP Cloud ALM. The consultant will work closely with functional, technical, testing, infrastructure, security and business teams to establish standardized, controlled and efficient lifecycle-management processes.
Exp Range-7-12 Yrs
Location- Pune/Bangalore/Gurgaon
Responsibilities
Manage and support end-to-end change-management processes using SAP Solution Manager ChaRM.
Configure and maintain change-document types, status flows, approval workflows and transaction types.
Support normal, urgent, emergency and defect-related change processes.
Ensure that changes are correctly assessed, approved, developed, tested, transported and closed.
Maintain integration between ChaRM, Transport Management System and SAP development landscapes.
Monitor transport dependencies, sequencing, conflicts, retrofit requirements and cross-system movements.
Support Change Advisory Board meetings by providing change status, risk, impact and implementation information.
Ensure compliance with audit, segregation-of-duties and change-control requirements.
Analyse failed or delayed changes and recommend process improvements.
Plan and coordinate SAP releases across multiple projects, applications and system landscapes.
Define release calendars, scope, milestones, cut-off dates and deployment windows.
Coordinate release readiness with business, functional, development, testing, security and infrastructure teams.
Track change requests, defects, testing status, approvals and transport readiness for each release.
Conduct release-readiness reviews and support go/no-go decision-making.
Coordinate production deployments, post-deployment validation and hypercare activities.
Manage release risks, dependencies, conflicts and rollback requirements.
Prepare release dashboards, deployment plans, release notes and management reports.
Support Focused Build processes for requirements, work packages, work items, defects, testing and deployment.
Configure and maintain project structures, waves, sprints, releases and governance workflows.
Ensure traceability from business requirements through design, development, testing and deployment.
Support Fit-to-Standard workshops and capture business requirements, gaps and implementation decisions.
Coordinate backlog management, prioritization and progress tracking.
Establish reporting for requirements, defects, test execution and release readiness.
Support integration between Focused Build, ChaRM, test management and transport processes.
Train project teams on Focused Build processes, roles and responsibilities.
Assess existing ChaRM, Focused Build and Solution Manager processes to identify Cloud ALM transition opportunities.
Define a phased transition roadmap from SAP Solution Manager to SAP Cloud ALM.
Map current requirements, change, test, deployment and monitoring processes to available Cloud ALM capabilities.
Identify process gaps, integration requirements and areas requiring temporary coexistence with existing tools.
Support the setup and adoption of SAP Cloud ALM for implementation and operations.
Configure project structures, task management, requirements, user stories, testing and deployment tracking.
Define governance for hybrid ALM environments during the transition period.
Coordinate data migration or archival requirements for relevant ALM artefacts.
Develop operating procedures, role definitions, templates and user guidance.
Track adoption and continuously improve Cloud ALM process.

Description:
About the Role
Are you a strategic operational leader with a strong track record in managing external service providers and driving operational excellence within a shared services environment? We are seeking a highly capable Regional BPO Manager to take ownership of all contractual and performance aspects of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Shared Service Centre (SSC) partners.
In this strategic management role, you will act as the vital bridge between our regional business stakeholders and our external BPO service provider across multiple outsourced process streams. While functional Tower Leads manage day-to-day process execution, you will ensure our BPO partners deliver against contractual commitments, achieve financial efficiency targets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and execute seamless process transitions.
Key Responsibilities
Contract & Commercial Management: Manage and coordinate all aspects of the BPO partner contract for the region. Oversee invoicing, timesheets, FTE approvals, volume modifications, service onboarding, and the tracking of contractual cost savings.
Relationship & Governance Ownership: Serve as the primary operational contact between internal regional business leadership and service provider management, driving alignment and acting as the escalation point for issue resolution.
Performance Management: Implement and maintain performance management frameworks using contractual KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with organizational benchmarks.
Regional Service Reviews: Lead regular Regional Service Reviews covering performance evaluations, issue mitigation, and future continuous improvement initiatives across all regional markets.
Transition Management: Oversee the onboarding and implementation of newly outsourced process workstreams into standard Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.
Change Governance: Develop and execute the formal change note approval process for contractual and scope updates.
Customer Satisfaction & Insights: Implement periodic internal customer satisfaction survey processes, translating stakeholder feedback into joint action plans with service providers to address operational gaps.
Financial & Budgetary Control: Manage annual and in-year financial budgets for shared service operations, ensuring partner costs accurately reflect productivity gains, scope shifts, and volume changes.
Risk & Quality Framework: Establish risk and control processes governing vendor activities while championing standard process documentation across provider teams.
Role Deliverables
Outsourced process operations delivered consistently within contractually agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Measurable productivity and efficiency savings achieved through structured process improvements.
Transparent, budget-aligned service provider costs reflecting volume dynamics, expanded scope, and savings targets.
Successful execution of the annual Customer Satisfaction Survey process with clear action plans implemented.
Required Skills and Experience
Outsourcing Expertise: Proven experience in managing complex, large-scale outsourced process operations across multi-location environments.
Performance Management: Track record of developing, monitoring, and driving vendor performance using structured KPI and SLA frameworks.
Process Transformation: Demonstrated ability to deliver process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives through SSC and BPO models.
Financial & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience developing and managing operational budgets, complex commercial contracts, and vendor change notes.
Functional Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of core Finance and HR process flows.
Stakeholder & Negotiation Skills: Excellent negotiation and bridge-building capabilities with the ability to translate complex process problems into clear, actionable, high-impact strategies for internal leadership and external partners.

Description:
Role: Quantitative Developer
Location: Mumbai/ Delhi (4 days working from office)
Shift: UK Shift (Afternoon Shift) (2:00pm to 11:00pm)
The Area: The Research & Investment group is a global team guided by Morningstars investment principles focused on delivering great long-term investment results to help end-investors reach their financial goals. We use our expertise in asset allocation, investment selection and portfolio construction to create world-class investment strategies leveraging the full resources of Morningstar. The group specializes in multi-asset investing, using building blocks in equities, fixed income and alternative investments to construct robust portfolios. Through our investment offerings, we serve financial advisers and institutions, and the investors that they serve.
Role Summary:
The Quantitative Developer will join the Systematic Strategies team in the Research & Investment group. This experienced professional will build scalable research infrastructure used by portfolio managers and quantitative researchers to develop, back test, and deploy multi asset models.
You should understand the nuances of the data and prepare it for ingestion, and your daily work with researchers and portfolio managers will facilitate the research, design, and deployment of investment strategies.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data engineering, cloud architecture, and financial systems.
Key Responsibilities:
The successful candidate will
Design and maintain scalable data pipelines for market, fundamental, and alternative datasets using Python, PySpark, FastAPI and AWS
Build and support investment data platforms, maintain databases and research datasets.
Integrate and automate data retrieval from internal/external providers such as FactSet, Morningstar, Axioma, and other third-party sources
Collaborate with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to support enhancement of production workflows
Automate operational processes through workflow orchestration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
Exposure to streaming data services and event-driven architectures used for real-time data ingestion, processing, and distribution
Evaluate and leverage AI/ML and Generative AI technologies to enhance analytics and operational efficiency
Requirements:
Strong expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data processing
Experience with Airflow, EMR, AWS Step Functions, Docker, Git, CI/CD, Terraform, and CloudFormation
Strong SQL skills and experience with Redshit, Athena, DataLake and Parquet
Experience of building AI agents & agentic workflow is desirable and will be considered a strong plus
Experience with handling financial data from vendors such as FactSet, Bloomberg, Morningstar, or Compustat
Exposure to portfolio analytics, risk modelling, performance attribution, and platforms such as Axioma, MSCI Barra, Bloomberg PORT, or similar solutions
Required Technical Skills
Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark
Experience with creating Data Pipelines
Exposure to cloud-based services, AWS (preferred)
Exposure to AI-powered productivity and development tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline
2+ years of experience in Quantitative Engineering, Data Engineering, or Platform Engineering within investment management or financial services
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.

Hitachi Energy Grid Integration (HVDC) offers an exciting opportunity to work with advanced High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC) technologies. You will be part of the Services team, supporting the installed base of HVDC systems by ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and customer satisfaction while contributing to the long-term performance and availability of critical power infrastructure.
How You'll Make an Impact
Demonstrate a strong commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards, policies, and guidelines.
Serve as the primary customer interface for the HVDC installed base and maintain strong customer relationships.
Perform troubleshooting and restoration activities for HVDC systems and equipment during failures or outages, in coordination with technical experts.

Prepare and maintain site documentation, including Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and service reports.
Review technical drawings, engineering documents, protection schemes, and operating procedures to support maintenance and fault resolution.
Participate in outage management, fault investigations, emergency response activities, and root cause analysis.
Ensure timely communication and coordination with technical support teams during critical service events.

Description:
Role Overview

CBRE seeks a Project Lead for Real Estate Portfolio Valuations to join the Valuation Excellence (VALEX) Team. This role combines strategic portfolio management, stakeholder coordination, and deep valuation expertise. You will oversee pan-India portfolio valuations for REITs, InvITs, and RE investment funds while driving innovation and automation across the valuation delivery model.

Position Details
Reports To - VALEX Head/Senior Director
Team Leadership - Manages 1 to 3 team members; potential for mentorship and cross-regional coordination
Location- Mumbai or NCR (multi-city flexibility expected)
Experience Required - Minimum 5 years of real estate valuation experience in India
Asset Classes - Core office, retail malls, warehousing, hospitality, residential, etc.
Geography - Pan-India portfolio management; multi-region experience is an advantage

Core Responsibilities

1. As Project Lead, you manage complex, high-stakes valuation assignments for institutional clients across India across REITs, InvITs, funds, and private investors.
2. Serve as the central coordinator between clients (often CFOs and investment committees) and internal regional teams, ensuring seamless communication, delivery and quality. You will be the single point of accountability.
3. Own project timelines and quality standards. Deliver valuations on schedule and in compliance with CBRE's quality frameworks.
4. Build and maintain client relationships to secure repeat business and identify upsell opportunities.
5. Provide asset-specific insights and market knowledge to clients. Translate technical valuations into clear, actionable recommendations.
6. Lead active involvement in valuation discussions and finalization with regional teams across North, South, East, and West India.
7. Review all reports for content quality and compliance with CBRE standards before client delivery.
8. Lead or support VALEX innovation initiatives that drive automation and improve team efficiency.
9. Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce manual work, and implement new valuation tools.

Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you must bring:

1. A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in real estate valuation within India.
2. Proven track record valuing core assets (office, retail, warehousing, hospitality, residential) across multiple Indian cities.
3. Strong financial modeling and analysis skills; comfort with DCF, income approach, and comparable sales analysis.
4. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects with competing priorities.
5. Clear communication skills; ability to explain valuation methodologies and findings to non-technical clients.
6. Educational background in civil engineering, real estate, architecture, or a related field (B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent).

Desired Qualifications

1. MRICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) or equivalent professional certification.
2. Experience in REIT and InvIT valuations across key metros.
3. Familiarity with CBRE's valuation processes, tools, or technology platforms.
4. Prior experience managing a small team or mentoring junior valuers.
5. Background in capital markets transactions or investment advisory.
6. Willingness to travel across regions for client meetings and team coordination.

Key Competencies

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise and leadership skills:

Valuation Mastery - Core technical expertise in DCF modeling, market research, and comparable analysis for multiple asset classes.
Project Management - Ability to juggle multiple portfolios, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate across distributed teams.
Client Relationship Management - Proven ability to build trust, manage expectations, and convert engagements into long-term partnerships.
Analytical Thinking - Comfort with complex real estate datasets, spotting trends, and translating numbers into strategic insights. Collaboration - Works effectively with regional teams, senior leadership, and external stakeholders; no siloed mentality.
Adaptability - Open to learning new technologies, valuation approaches, and market dynamics; willing to upskill continuously.
Communication - Can articulate complex financial concepts in clear, jargon-free language for diverse audiences.

Your Impact on VALEX

The VALEX team is CBRE's centralized excellence unit for real estate valuations. As a Project Lead, you will:

1. Drive consistency in valuation standards across all 400+ team members and multiple regions.
2. Identify bottlenecks in current delivery workflows and champion automation initiatives.
3. Move beyond regional expertise. Coordinate pan-India complexity. This breadth is rare and globally marketable
4. Mentor junior team members on best practices, portfolio management, and client engagement.
5. Serve as a subject matter expert on specific asset classes and geographies.
6. Contribute to the continuous improvement culture that underpins VALEX's mission.
7. Build a skill set that makes you invaluable: master every Indian asset class, become fluent in REIT/InvIT structuring, develop advanced modeling skills and lead teams.

Learning and Growth

This role offers deep opportunity for professional development. You'll be expected to stay current on:
1. Advanced financial modeling techniques and emerging valuation methodologies.
2. Real estate market dynamics, sector trends, and macroeconomic factors affecting India's asset classes.
3. CBRE's proprietary tools, technology platforms, and analytics dashboards.
4. Team leadership and mentoring skills to support junior professionals.
5. Automation and workflow optimization to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

Why Join CBRE VALEX?

1. Work with India's most sophisticated real estate portfolios across REITs, funds, and institutional investors.
2. Be part of a high-performing centralized team focused on innovation, consistency, and excellence.
3. Access to world-class training, CBRE's global knowledge, and leading technology platforms.
4. Clear career path: grow your technical expertise, build team leadership capabilities, and move into senior roles.
5. A culture of continuous learning; CBRE invests in upskilling and professional certifications.
6. Collaborative, multi-regional environment with exposure to diverse asset classes and market geographies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit the following:

1. A detailed resume highlighting your valuation experience across asset classes and geographies.
2. A cover letter explaining your interest in VALEX and how your background aligns with this role.
3. A portfolio example or case study demonstrating your valuation approach and client communication style (if available).
4. References from clients or managers who can speak to your project delivery and relationship management

Interpret study results and prepare technical reports, presentations, and recommendations.

Description:
Company -Saint Gobain India Pvt Ltd
Location -Mumbai
Experience 0-3 years

Job Description
Position Overview: We are seeking an Application Support Manager to help Business Owners and Application Manager through the application approval process. The Position will support them in designing and implementing applications in compliance with internal policies, frameworks, and cybersecurity procedures. While the Business Owner remains accountable for the application’s compliance, and the Application Manager is responsible for delivery during the project security assessment, this role will act as a key enabler for non-technical Application Managers. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of our internal IT and cybersecurity processes, frameworks, and governance requirements, and will work to ensure smooth, timely progress in the security approval process.

Responsibilities:
Project Coordination and Support: Keep the application approval process on track by providing administrative support, sending reminders, collecting necessary documentation, and facilitating communication between Application Managers, Business Owners, and security teams. Ensure the timely completion of all steps in the application approval workflow.
Collaborate with Business Owners and Application Managers: Work with Business Owners and their Legal to understand and document the business, legal, and regulatory requirements for their applications, ensuring with the Application Manager the later alignment of business objectives with security policies. While the Business Owner remains accountable and the Application Manager responsible for the application, your role is to support them in navigating security requirements.
Assist in Technical Documentation: Help create and review architectural drawings and flow matrices, ensuring all IT flows are in compliance with internal security policies and governance standards.
The aim is to deliver a compliant and exhaustive Documentation to the Security Officer for review and validation.
Mediate between Security Officer and Business: Support the Security Officer addressing Security Needs and Gaps to the Business and the Business to deliver quality documentation to ease the security approval process.
Vendor Governance: Support the vendor during Vendor Cybersecurity Assessment as a first Level Support, ensuring the process, scope and questions are well-understood. Support the Vendor and the Business in resolving Gaps the Security Officer has highlighted during the Assessment. The Application Manager and his/her Purchasing will remain responsible for vendor management.
Support Security Measures and Service Integration: Advise on and help implementing security measures, such as encryption, authentication, data protection or role-based access control and assist the integration of applications with enterprise services such as IAM, EDI or Protection Services.
Vulnerability Management: Coordinate vulnerability scanning requests, help interpret the results, and provide first-level Support to Application Managers and Business Owners in understanding and addressing identified vulnerabilities

Qualifications:
Knowledge of Internal IT and Security Policies and Processes: While you can always rely on the Business Security Officer for expertise Knowledge, you should have a good understanding of the company’s internal cybersecurity processes, security frameworks, and compliance requirements.
Organizational & Communication Skills: Very good ability to manage multiple stakeholders, track progress, and ensure timely completion of tasks while communicating clearly and effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Project Coordination: Experience supporting projects, managing timelines, and facilitating coordination between different teams to keep processes moving forward.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to assist non-technical teams in addressing security challenges and aligning them with internal requirements, while ensuring that accountability for decision-making remains with the Business Owner and Application Manager.
Security Awareness: While deep security expertise is not required, familiarity with security best practices and the ability to support technical teams in applying internal cybersecurity processes is essential.

About the Role:
The Operations Executive / Sr. Operations Executive will be responsible for ensuring service quality, technician capability, material readiness, and compliance through hands-on supervision, audits, and performance monitoring across assigned service areas.
The incumbent will report to the AOM/OM/ABM/BM. The incumbent will have to work as part of a multi-functional team, and this involves collaboration with the internal team and external stakeholders

Job Responsibilities:
A. Core Operations
Ensure availability of trained & certified technicians as per guidelines.
Coach technicians to improve service quality, retention, and SOP compliance.
Conduct daily stand-up meetings; communicate safety & job-specific instructions.
Ensure availability of tools, materials, and proper stock management as per SOP.
Monitor SCP usage, troubleshoot issues, and provide refresher training.
Ensure Partner Kit & on-site documentation are contractually compliant.
Conduct customer visits/week (Surprise, Route rides, Audits, Complaints). - based on the target
Maintain grooming standards and service quality of assigned technicians.
Ensure data entries in iCABS during manpower gaps to meet branch KPIs.
Approve technician conveyance; ensure STT and route plan adherence.
Ensure RPCI SOPs are complied with and any deviations that are necessary should be adequately approved in advance.

B. Advanced Operations
Conduct Pest Audits (PMI) as per iCABS (QSRs & small accounts).
Execute 1 TPA + 1 development plan annually per technician.
Analyse & resolve service delivery issues; ensure timely complaint resolution with root cause closure.
Monitor technician-wise CO trends; skill-up underperformers.
Ensure audit non-conformity closures (internal/external).
Track material usage vs. SRF/SOW; highlight deviations.
Maintain stock levels aligned with APL and reduce near-expiry wastage.
Drive service & product leads through coaching and on-the-job support.
Monitor service productivity, efficiency, and input costs across sites.
Support grievance handling, leave planning, and team discipline.

Key Result Areas:
100% completion of PMI 'Pest Audit'
Material Consumption
TPA and Development Plan
Technician Capability Development
Complaint Resolution & Root Cause Analysis
Customer Visit & Audit Coverage

Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Strong interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Effective communication skills
Proactive planning and organising
Technical knowledge of pests, service processes, chemicals, and equipment

Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum B.Sc. in Agriculture, only agriculture background can apply
Prior experience in pest management or service operations is preferred
Proficient MS-Office / G-Suite

What can you expect from RPCI?
Our values lie at the core of our mission and vision. We believe that its our people who make our company what it is. We believe in:
Service
Relationships
Teamwork
Responsibility

Job Summary:
Responsible for the preparation of analyses and reports for department managers. Supports the annual budget process, expense and/or staffing forecasts or statistical reporting.
Key Responsibilities:
Prepares analyses and reports for department managers. Works with assigned organizational unit(s) to develop annual budgets, expense and staffing forecasts, and statistical reporting. Supports month end close. Prepares and consolidates financial data. Prepares statistical reporting, including financial performance, variance explanations, and cost analysis. Executes special projects as assigned.
Education Qualification : CA
Experience - 0-2 years
Financial Reporting Analysis
Manufacturing Overheads Analysis
AOP Forecast Submission
Financial Reporting
Stakeholder Management
Analyze financial data to support departmental budgets and forecasts.
Explain expense variances and support initiatives to improve cost awareness across the organization.
Support Plant Controller for statutory audit , cost audit and internal audit deliverables.
Financial Operations Processes
Participate in special projects as assigned and complete ad hoc reporting requests as required.
Note - This position will be part of the India Finance Development Program (IFDP), a rotation program for fresh Chartered Accountants with 0-2 yrs of experience where the participant will get varied experience in 3 domains through 3 roles over a period of 4 years. 2 of these roles will be mandatory - one in Plant Finance and one in Controls - with the 3rd role based on business requirement and / or the participants interest.
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Business Partnering - Collaborates with stakeholders and develops partnerships to drive performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies; influences the organization by demonstrating knowledge of the business to provide guidance to support the decision making process and guiding the business towards positive results and organizational alignment; evaluates business environment using measures to mitigate risk and capitalize on opportunities.

Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues.

Financial Reporting - Analyzes financial data by evaluating results and solutions to support business decisions; prepares and presents financial information by summarizing data to communicate results in compliance with regulations and stakeholder expectations; partners with stakeholders to drive financial performance that aligns to organizational goals and strategies.

US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles - Evaluates US accounting standards to record transactions in compliance with requirements and company policies; assesses the accounting requirements and objectives to determine the implications on the business and communicate to stakeholders with varying financial knowledge.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or related field required.

Experience:
Minimal relevant professional work experience in the field of study required.

Description:
Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance

About
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloittes clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.

Work you’ll do
The key job responsibilities will be to:
• Conduct/lead client interviews, communication and follow ups
• Primarily involved in performing SOX, and Internal Audit reviews. Also, apply understanding of controls testing, and perform SSAE18 reviews.
• Perform internal audit assurance activities (internal audits over financial, operational, compliance, and strategic risk areas as well as execution of SOX-related activities and EQARs), consult with engagement leadership and clients on strategic plans and other business matters, and help to anticipate emerging risks for our clients
• Use problem solving and critical thinking skills to quickly identify internal control deficiencies, evaluate their risk implications, and draw the appropriate conclusions to best advise our clients
• Demonstrate ability to research, organize, and analyze data and execute selected tests of internal controls
• Perform business cycle controls and general computer controls review / testing
• Build and nurture positive working relationships with clients, by providing high quality deliverables and communications
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services
• Support client engagements by helping plan the audit approach and scope, preparing the audit program, determining auditing procedures, seeing the audit process through completion, and applying internal audit standards
• Create internal control documentation for the engagement including narratives, process and data flows, and other supporting work papers
• Demonstrate ability to prepare and present concise and easy to understand reporting to the client and other stakeholders
• Demonstrate ability to identify, discuss and agree audit outcomes with stakeholders and work towards finalizing action plan to address the findings/gaps/risks
• Exercise professional skepticism, judgment and adhere to the code of ethics while on engagements
• Identifying and evaluation of complex business risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement along with in depth understanding and knowledge of ERP (Oracle/SAP), COSO and US GAAP to bring greater value to the clients. Further, demonstrating the understanding and applicability of the recent updates from Institute for Internal Auditors (IIA), Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) and American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) guidance
• Continually develop technical and professional skills through continuous learning programs
• Support organization and function initiatives

Location: Hyderabad

Qualification
• Chartered Accountant/MBA in Finance/Relevant certification (e.g. CPA, CIA and CISA)

Required skills
• Experience — Up to 4yrs of relevant work experience
• Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, financial, and IT auditing
• Experience with SOX, Internal Audit, and SSAE18
• Exposure to work across industries - Technology media and telecommunication, Manufacturing/ Consumer, Life Sciences and Health Care, Energy Resources, Financial services (preferred)
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), positive attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile
• Strong analytical, critical thinking/problem-solving skills and executive presence. Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels.
• Willingness to expand skillset and work on other related areas

Preferred skills
• Big 4 experience

Description:
Personal Secretary to the Managing Director (MD)
Company: Aakash Fertility Centre & Hospital
Location: Vadapalani, Chennai
Employment Type: Full Time | Permanent
Experience: 6 Months 2 Years
Salary: ( experience, and interview performance)
About the Role
Aakash Fertility Centre & Hospital is seeking a dynamic, highly organized, and professional Personal Secretary to the Managing Director (MD) to provide comprehensive executive and administrative support. This role demands exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, strong organizational capabilities, and the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
The ideal candidate will act as a trusted point of coordination for the Managing Director, ensuring efficient management of schedules, communications, documentation, and executive priorities while contributing to the smooth functioning of the Executive Office.
Key Responsibilities
Provide dedicated executive and administrative support to the Managing Director.
Manage the MD's calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule with efficiency and accuracy.
Coordinate internal and external meetings, prepare agendas, document Minutes of Meeting (MoM), and ensure timely follow-up on action items.
Draft, review, and manage professional correspondence, emails, reports, presentations, and official documents.
Screen and prioritize phone calls, emails, and visitors, ensuring effective communication and appropriate escalation where required.
Liaise with department heads, consultants, vendors, and external stakeholders on behalf of the Managing Director.
Maintain confidential records, agreements, reports, and sensitive business information with complete discretion.
Organize travel arrangements, accommodation, and other executive logistics whenever required.
Track key deliverables, monitor deadlines, and ensure timely follow-up on pending assignments.
Maintain systematic documentation and filing for easy retrieval and compliance.
Support the Managing Director in strategic, operational, and administrative initiatives as assigned.
Uphold professionalism, confidentiality, and efficiency in all interactions and responsibilities.
Candidate Profile
Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
6 months to 2 years of experience as a Personal Secretary, Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, or similar executive support role.
Experience in a healthcare or hospital environment will be an added advantage.
Excellent command of spoken and written English is mandatory.
Strong interpersonal, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
High level of integrity with the ability to handle confidential information.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management abilities.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, professional environment.
Well-presented, proactive, and detail-oriented with a positive attitude.

Industry: Hospital & Healthcare
Department: Executive Office / Administration
AboutCompany:
Our FERTILITY SPECIALISTS are thought leaders in the field of reproductive medicine & infertility. As a highly collaborative team, they share the latest technologies and evidence-based practices with their colleagues, as illustrated through our Centers of Excellence. Our specialists are honored to apply their shared expertise as leaders in the field, towards each and every patients individual treatment.
Cutting Edge Technology
Advanced medical education and research are an important foundation for the services we provide, as the latest treatment methods and technology means better treatment options for you. We frequently partner with the industry leaders to conduct clinical research studies in an effort to remain at the forefront of medical advances and techniques so that we can offer the most comprehensive and technologically innovative fertility care available.
Empowering Informed Decisions
We place extra attention on providing you with the right information to help you make informed decisions about your fertility treatment and other available options. Our Center enables our teams to utilize the latest advancements in treatment options and technology. This ensures that you are receiving the best possible treatment for your individual diagnosis.
Donor and Surrogacy Innovations
Our Center provides a single, comprehensive source of information and support in the areas of egg and embryo donation, sperm donation and surrogacy options. We will work with you to help guide you through the intricacies of collaborative reproduction
A Commitment to Support and Guidance
We understand that the journey towards parenthood can be a transformative experience that can profoundly affect you emotionally as well as physically. Therefore, we offer many different types of support to care for you on all levels.
Our licensed clinical psychologists are available to help you navigate the emotional landscape of your journey and provide supportive discussion to assist in handling all aspects of your treatment.
Aakash Fertility Center & hospital with holistic treatment providers , provide complementary therapy in conjunction with your traditional treatment, such as acupuncture, nutritional counseling, yoga classes, and many other offerings that can enhance your experience and empower you emotionally and physically.
Our entire team, from Specialists to nurses all the way to the administrative support, is honored to support you. We celebrate your successes and help you through any struggles as if they were our own. Many of our team members have personal experience with infertility and draw on this to make your journey easier.
Affordable Fertility
In addition to accepting many insurance providers, we have financial strategies to help make your journey to parenthood more affordable, including self-pay discounts, medication and treatment discount programs, discounts for the military and more. Our team of specialists will help you navigate the options that are available to you.
Nothing gives us greater joy than helping people become parents. We welcome the opportunity to discuss your individual situation and your future family planning goals. We invite you to contact us directly to learn more about how we can help you achieve your miracle of family.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.

Language Skills

Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

About the Role

We are looking for a Renewable Energy Engineer to support the Department of Energy, Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in monitoring and implementing key renewable energy programs, including PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY) and PM-KUSUM.

Exposure to project monitoring, implementation, or advisory assignments.

Skills
Good understanding of renewable energy projects and government programs.
Strong analytical, coordination, and communication skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Excellent written and spoken English.

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development . The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers .
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products .
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales .
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales & Business Development
Dealer & Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand & Product Promotion
Channel Sales & Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market , good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets .
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Renewable Energy Expert / Team Leader to support the Government of Chhattisgarh/Tripura in strengthening renewable energy program monitoring, project management, and capacity-building initiatives. The selected expert will work closely with the State Energy Department, Renewable Energy Development Agency (REDA), and DISCOMs to drive effective implementation and oversight of renewable energy projects.

Location
Raipur, Chhattisgarh/ Agartala, Tripura (Full-time deployment with State Energy Department)

Assignment Duration- 1 year

Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Project Management
Lead and manage the overall delivery of the assignment.
Coordinate project activities, stakeholders, and reporting requirements.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the State Energy Department and associated agencies.
Monitor project progress and ensure timely delivery of outputs and milestones.
Conduct impact assessments and provide strategic recommendations.
Prepare and submit project completion reports.

Renewable Energy Advisory
Lead program monitoring and management activities for renewable energy projects in Chhattisgarh/Tripura
Support State Energy Department, REDA, and DISCOMs in project implementation and performance monitoring.
Identify project risks and recommend mitigation measures.
Facilitate training programs and capacity-building workshops for government officials and utility staff.
Provide technical advisory support related to renewable energy sector initiatives.

Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Master's Degree in Engineering, Management, MBA, or related field preferred.

Experience
Proven experience managing projects of similar scale and complexity.
Familiarity with ADB or other Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) funded projects.
Experience supporting state-owned power utilities, renewable energy agencies, or government energy departments.
Demonstrated involvement in monitoring or managing at least two renewable energy projects.
Minimum 4 years of experience working with renewable energy companies in India.

Skills
Strong stakeholder engagement and project management capabilities.
Understanding of renewable energy policies, utility operations, and sector programs.
Excellent communication and reporting skills.
Proficiency in MS Office Suite.

Language
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Please note that this is fixed term role, contingent upon winning the bid.

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features

Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
