Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Job Opening: Deputy Manager Accounting & Commercial (Cable Division)

Experience: 4 - 5 years
Compensation: 20 LPA 25 LPA
Age Limit: 25–35 years

Financial Accounting & Closure: Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting, plant/project accounting, and ensure timely month-end financial closure for the Cable Division.
Commercial Governance: Oversee vendor contract evaluations, customer credit management, receivables tracking, and commercial terms verification.

Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (Mandatory).
Experience: 4 to 5 years of post-qualification experience in Accounting, Commercial Finance, Plant Finance, or Business Finance within a manufacturing environment (Cable, Electrical, Capital Goods, or Process Manufacturing preferred).

Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

Job Description: Regional Manager Automobile Sales

Company: CARS24
Locations: Ahmedabad, Pune, Rajkot
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com

About the Role

CARS24 is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Regional Manager to lead automobile sales and retail operations across the assigned region. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in automotive sales, business development, team leadership, and achieving sales targets, preferably in the used-car or new-car dealership industry.

Key Responsibilities
*Regional Sales Management: Drive automobile sales and business growth across multiple locations within the assigned region.
*Business Development: Develop strategies to increase vehicle sales, procurement, revenue, and market share.
*Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor sales managers and frontline sales teams to achieve business objectives.
*Dealer & Partner Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with new-car dealerships, used-car dealers, and other automotive business partners.
*Target Achievement: Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, inventory movement, and key business KPIs to ensure targets are met.
*Market Expansion: Identify new business opportunities, strengthen market presence, and expand the regional dealer network.
*Customer Experience: Ensure a smooth customer journey and maintain high standards of service and customer satisfaction.
*Performance Monitoring: Analyse regional sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
*Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to company processes, sales policies, and operational standards.
*Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with procurement, operations, and other teams to improve business performance.
Candidate Requirements
*2-8 years of experience in automobile sales, preferably in the used-car, new-car dealership, automotive retail, or automotive e-commerce industry.
*Prior experience in managing sales teams and driving regional or multi-location business performance.
*Strong understanding of automobile sales, dealer relationships, vehicle procurement and retail operations.
*Proven ability to achieve sales targets, improve conversions, and drive revenue growth.
*Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
*Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on business KPIs.
*A go-getter mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
What Were Looking For
A strong sales leader with a passion for the automobile industry who can drive regional growth, build high-performing teams, strengthen dealer partnerships, and deliver sustainable business results.

Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities

Coordinate with MNC customers to understand and fulfil their daily transportation and logistics requirements.
Receive transport indents, vehicle requirements, dispatch schedules, and delivery instructions from customers.
Coordinate with the existing operations team and transporters to ensure timely vehicle placement and smooth execution of transport orders.
Maintain professional relationships with customer logistics, dispatch, and supply chain teams.
Participate in customer portal activities, including freight rate submissions, online bidding, and e-auctions, as required.
Monitor customer portals for new requirements, bidding deadlines, and awarded transport orders.
Coordinate with management for freight rate approvals and commercial decisions before submitting quotations or participating in auctions.
Operate the company's internal logistics software for transport entries, workflow management, shipment updates, and operational tracking.
Track vehicle placement, loading, dispatch, transit, and delivery status, and provide timely updates to customers.
Coordinate with drivers, vehicle owners, transporters, and internal staff to resolve operational issues and delivery delays.
Ensure proper preparation and collection of LR copies, PODs, and other transportation documents.
Prepare daily operational reports covering pending indents, vehicle placement, dispatches, deliveries, and outstanding operational issues.
Coordinate with the accounts and billing teams to resolve documentation discrepancies and support timely invoicing.
Perform other logistics and transport-related responsibilities assigned by management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Graduate in any discipline; B.Com, BBA, or a logistics-related qualification preferred.
15 years of experience in logistics coordination, road transportation, dispatch, or transport operations.
Experience dealing with MNC customers, industrial clients, or corporate logistics teams will be an advantage.
Knowledge of vehicle placement, transporter coordination, freight rates, and dispatch management preferred.
Prior experience with customer portals, freight bidding, or e-auctions is desirable but not mandatory. Training will be provided where required.
Basic to good working knowledge of MS Excel, email, and computer-based applications.
Willingness to learn and operate the company's internal logistics software and customer-specific portals.
Good communication, coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple transport requirements, follow deadlines, and coordinate effectively with customers and internal teams.
Responsible, proactive, organised, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of ownership.

Perks and Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience, skills, and suitability.
Monthly fuel expense reimbursement for eligible business-related expenses, as per company policy.
Group health insurance coverage under the company's applicable policy.
Opportunity to work with reputed multinational companies and industrial customers.
Practical exposure to transport operations, freight bidding, customer portals, and logistics management.
Learning and career growth opportunities within the logistics and transportation industry.
Professional working environment with opportunities to take on greater responsibilities based on performance.
AboutCompany:
M.J. & SONS SURAT is a proud member of the MJ Group, engaged in road transportation and logistics services for reputed multinational corporations (MNCs) and industrial clients. With over three decades of industry experience, the company focuses on reliable logistics solutions, professional service, and long-term customer relationships.
Our services include road transportation, pan-India logistics, specialised and over-dimensional cargo movement, and transportation solutions under rate contracts. We are committed to ethical business practices, operational efficiency, transparency, and customer satisfaction.
At M.J. & SONS SURAT, we believe our people are an important part of our success. We offer opportunities to work with established industrial clients, develop professional skills, and grow within a business that values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Achieve monthly sales and conversion targets

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales Approach and Target Orientation: The desired RMH candidate must have an excellent aptitude for sales and marketing and must be very focused towards generating quality leads with maximum probability for conversion. He/she must have a strong orientation to generate and bring new customers to the branches and add new customers to our fold.
2. Exceptional Planning and Execution Skills: RMH must plan and execute the local flavored activities for the branches of the Region allocated to the RMH to ensure that the branches achieve their monthly and quarterly business targets of New Customer Acquisition for Gold Loan and Other Financial Products. New customer acquisition (new KYC) is the primary metric on which an RMHs effectiveness will be measured and hence RMHs primary focus must be to ensure his/her Region achieves its new KYC target without fail.
3. Monitoring Skills: RMHs must coordinate with the branches and the vendors on a regular basis to ensure the proper execution of the sanctioned regional BTL activities. He/she should have the ability to take branch staff along and ensure the BTL activities are conducted effectively and collectively to create top quality leads. He/she should also have the ability to foresee if there are any possible leakages or misreporting being done at agency level and should be able to check it, plug it and correct it.
4. Competition Tracking & Monitoring: RMH should proactively visit branches of competitors and prepare a counter competition strategy on a monthly / Quarterly basis to highlight what competitors are doing in his Region at BTL level and how does he/she plan to counter it.
5. Branch visits: All branches of in his/her Region must be visited by the RMH at least once in every Quarter to understand the on-ground issues, faade related branding issues, use/misuse of branch collaterals and merchandise, understand the branchs catchment area, competitors active in the respective branchs neighborhood and then finally plan and execute effective marketing initiatives which are specific to the branch, to address identified issues.
6. Branch Branding and Visual Branch Merchandise: RMH must ensuring effective branch branding, ensuring every branch in his Region stands out and is well-equipped with prominent and well-placed lit Glow Sign Boards (GSBs and Vertical GSBs), suitable quantity of branch merchandise, collaterals etc It is also his/ her responsibility to ensure that no branch has abundance of marketing collaterals / marketing material which lies unused or gets wasted later. Thus, his / her role does not end with just supplying this material but also includes their best utilization to drive business impact and ensure nil wastage.
7. Branch Launch: Whenever a new branch is being opened, RMH is entrusted with preparing a detailed report on the available opportunity in the branch’s catchment area and once the branch opening date is finalized, he/she is expected to plan a detailed marketing plan with various new branch opening activities that create awareness in the neighborhood and also drives footfall and business conversion for the new branch.
8. Vendor Management: RMH is expected to bring with him/her a good network of vendors, marketing agencies, partners, and collaborators with whom he can work closely to execute his marketing plans. Description:
Wockhardt Hospitals Limited is looking for Critical Care Medicine to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Patient Assessment : Perform comprehensive assessments of critically ill patients to determine medical conditions and treatment needs. Treatment Planning : Develop and implement individualized treatment plans for patients in the intensive care unit, addressing their specific medical needs. Ventilator Management : Manage and oversee mechanical ventilation for patients requiring respiratory support. Monitoring : Utilize advanced monitoring equipment to assess patients' vital signs and respond promptly to changes in their condition. Diagnostic Procedures : Perform and interpret diagnostic procedures, such as chest X-rays, echocardiograms, and laboratory tests. Collaboration : Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including surgeons, nurses, and respiratory therapists, to optimize patient care. Family Communication : Communicate effectively with patients' families, providing updates on the patient's condition, treatment plan, and prognosis. Emergency Response : Respond to medical emergencies within the hospital, particularly in critical care areas. Documentation : Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records, documenting patient assessments, interventions, and outcomes.

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 6 to 12 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams
- Excellent communication
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Description:
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Site Industrial Planner in Savli we're looking for.
Take on a new challenge and apply your industrial planning expertise in a cutting-edge field. You'll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and customer-focused teammates.
You'll play a key role in ensuring the adequacy between demand (firm forecast) and resources (manufacturing procurement) to meet customer expectations in terms of quality, cost, and delivery, while optimizing site resources such as people, machines, and cash. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with teams across the business (such as manufacturing, procurement, and planning teams), ensure the application of Industrial Planning Golden Rules, and contribute to the APSYS (Alstom Performance System) roadmap actions related to industrial planning topics, and much more.
You'll specifically take care of demand management and scheduling in the Core Planning Tools and/or ERP, but also ensure compliance with Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) rules when moving in workshops.
Responsibilities
Ensuring the application of Industrial Planning Golden Rules and processes
Contributing to achieving Industrial Planning KPIs targets
Driving actions related to the APSYS roadmap for industrial planning
Managing demand and scheduling in Core Planning Tools and/or ERP
Applying and ensuring compliance with EHS rules (Alstom Zero Deviation Plan)
Supporting the team with innovative solutions to improve ways of working
Requirements
Degree in a relevant field
Experience in industrial planning
Knowledgeable of End-to-End (E2E) vision for Industrial Planning processes and their impact in ERP for procurement and manufacturing
Scheduling basics knowledge
Good knowledge of Core Planning Tools, ERP, and Excel
Good level of English
Team management experience (desirable)
Strong communication and collaborative skills
Innovative, proactive, and customer-oriented mindset
Sense of urgency and ability to synthesize critical issues
Autonomy and a positive, solution-driven approach
You don't need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. If you're up for the challenge, we'd love to hear from you!

Description:
Role: Senior Microsoft 365 (Office 365) & Cloud Administrator
Team: IT Infrastructure / Cloud Operations
Experience: 812 years total, with at least 5 years administering Microsoft 365 at enterprise scale and at least 3 years administering Azure (AWS exposure is an added advantage)
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary
We are looking for a Senior Microsoft 365 & Cloud Administrator to manage, secure, and optimise our Microsoft 365 collaboration platform and cloud infrastructure. The incumbent will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, security, compliance, and continuous improvement of Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Entra ID, Intune, Purview, and Defender, along with Azure cloud resources supporting enterprise and business applications.
The role combines hands-on administration with senior ownership, including designing policies, leading migrations and rollouts, managing escalations, automating operations, and ensuring the environment meets security, data protection, and regulatory requirements expected in a pharmaceutical organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Microsoft 365 Administration
Administer and maintain the Microsoft 365 tenant, including tenant settings, service health, Message Center updates, and licensing.
Manage Exchange Online, including mailbox administration, distribution groups, mail flow, transport rules, connectors, retention policies, journaling, and hybrid Exchange environments.
Manage SharePoint Online and OneDrive, including site architecture, permissions, sharing policies, storage, lifecycle management, and governance.
Administer Microsoft Teams, including governance, policies, meeting and calling configurations, guest/external access, and lifecycle management.
Manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment, update channels, and add-ins.
Administer Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), including DLP policies and governance.
Govern Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI features, including licensing, data access readiness, oversharing remediation, sensitivity labels, and usage policies.
Plan and execute tenant, mailbox, and file migrations, including tenant-to-tenant consolidations.

2. Identity and Access Management
Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including users, groups, dynamic groups, guest users, app registrations, and enterprise applications.
Manage hybrid identity using Entra Connect/Cloud Sync and on-premises Active Directory.
Configure and maintain Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR), and risk-based policies.
Implement Privileged Identity Management (PIM), role-based access control (RBAC), access reviews, and identity governance processes.
Integrate SaaS and enterprise applications using SSO (SAML, OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.

3. Endpoint and Device Management
Manage device enrolment and administration through Microsoft Intune, including Autopilot, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, and patch management.
Administer mobile device and application protection policies (MAM) for BYOD and corporate devices.
Coordinate with endpoint and security teams on Windows Update for Business and device hardening standards.

4. Security and Threat Protection
Administer the Microsoft Defender Suite, including Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Cloud Apps.
Monitor and improve Microsoft Secure Score and Identity Secure Score.
Investigate and respond to security incidents, including phishing attacks, compromised accounts, and suspicious sign-ins.
Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to protect against spoofing and impersonation.
Integrate Microsoft 365 and Azure logs with SIEM solutions such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk.

5. Compliance, Data Protection and Governance
Administer Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention policies, records management, eDiscovery, audit logs, and insider risk management.
Align retention and records management practices with organisational policies and legal hold requirements.
Support GxP-relevant collaboration use cases in line with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and ALCOA+ principles.
Support compliance initiatives related to GDPR, India DPDP Act, and internal/external audits.
Manage Microsoft 365 backup and recovery solutions such as Microsoft 365 Backup, Veeam, AvePoint, or Druva.

6. Cloud Administration (Azure & Multi-Cloud)
Administer Azure subscriptions and services, including VMs, storage accounts, virtual networks, NSGs, load balancers, App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and backup services.
Manage Azure resource organisation through management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, tagging, and Azure Policy.
Implement and maintain RBAC, managed identities, and secure cloud access controls.
Monitor cloud resources using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerting mechanisms.
Manage Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and disaster recovery testing.
Support hybrid connectivity through VPN and ExpressRoute integrations.
Optimise cloud costs using Azure Cost Management and resource rightsizing.
Support AWS and other cloud platforms where required.

7. Automation and Operations
Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Azure CLI, Azure Automation, and Logic Apps.
Utilise Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep, ARM Templates, or Terraform.
Maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documentation, and change records.
Handle L2/L3 escalations and perform root cause analysis.
Follow ITIL processes for Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request Management.
Monitor Microsoft product roadmaps and assess their organisational impact.

8. Leadership and Collaboration
Mentor junior administrators and service desk teams.
Collaborate with security, network, application, QA, and business teams on projects and operational requirements.
Manage Microsoft partners and vendors for support, licensing, and project delivery.
Drive user adoption of collaboration technologies and security best practices.

Required Skills & Experience
Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
Expertise in Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, and hybrid identity management.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview.
Strong Azure administration experience covering compute, storage, networking, RBAC, monitoring, policy management, and backup.
Expertise in PowerShell scripting and Microsoft Graph.
Experience managing Microsoft 365 licensing (E3, E5, add-ons) and licence optimisation.
Experience in tenant migrations, governance, and large-scale enterprise environments with thousands of users.
Strong understanding of ITIL processes and change management.
Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated environments is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Microsoft certifications such as:
MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert
AZ-104: Azure Administrator Associate
SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator
SC-400 / SC-401: Information Protection Administrator
MD-102: Endpoint Administrator
AZ-305: Azure Solutions Architect
ITIL Foundation Certification.
Exposure to AWS administration and multi-cloud environments.
Experience deploying and governing Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Description:
Greetings from TATA MOTORS !

We are currently hiring for a Senior Manager - Machine Shop Production - Powertrain for our passenger vehicle facility in Sanand, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Detailed JD as follows:

Role Purpose
Lead the Cylinder Head Machining operations within the Powertrain Manufacturing function, ensuring delivery of production, quality, cost, safety, and productivity targets. Drive manufacturing excellence through process capability enhancement, TPM implementation, continuous improvement initiatives, and people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Production & Operations Management
Drive daily production performance to achieve volume, quality, cost, and delivery targets.
Lead machining operations for cylinder head manufacturing lines.
Ensure optimum machine utilization, manpower deployment, and resource planning.
Support new product introduction, machining line setup, commissioning, and production ramp-up.
Drive capacity enhancement through debottlenecking and process optimization.

Process Engineering & Technical Excellence
Provide technical leadership on CNC machining processes including milling, boring, honing, drilling, reaming, and finish machining.
Drive CNC programming, tool optimization, machine setting, component trials, and process validation.

Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.

Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Opportunity to work with India's leading eyewear brand

Comprehensive training and support

Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expectedt o be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs.Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Note :
Family Insurance Policy and Monthly Incentive policy
Professionalized Training with Lenskart Academy ( Mandatory )

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role & responsibilities
Our clients are leading MNC & Industrial Conglomerates (AUTOMOBILES, FMCG, CONSUMER DURABLES, MANAUFACTURING, RETAIL, EPC, INFRASTRUCTURE (POWER, ENERGY, OIL & GAS, PORTS), INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY, BPO, PHARMA & TELECOM with a Turnover of US $ 1 Bn to US $ 100 Bn with exponential growth potential. Our client’s reach span across several countries across the globe.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Description:
Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes for GenAI projects.
- Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to implement machine learning models and algorithms.
- Optimize data infrastructure and storage solutions to ensure efficient and scalable data processing.
- Implement event-driven architectures to enable real-time data processing and analysis.
- Utilize containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Develop and maintain data lakes for storing and managing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
- Implement and integrate LLM frameworks (Langchain, Semantic Kernel) for advanced language processing and analysis.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solution architectures for GenAI projects.
- Utilize cloud computing platforms such as Azure or AWS for data processing, storage, and deployment.
- Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and systems to ensure smooth and uninterrupted data flow.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance data engineering processes.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Document data engineering processes, methodologies, and best practices.
- Maintain solution architecture certificates and stay current with industry best practices.
Requirements:
Python Proficiency: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building applications with Python.
Scalable System Design: Solid understanding of designing and architecting scalable Python applications, particularly for Gen AI use cases, with a strong understanding of various components and systems architecture patterns to make cohesive and decoupled, scalable applications.
Web Frameworks: Familiarity with Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) for building web applications around AI models.
Modular Design & Security: Demonstrated ability to design applications with modularity, reusability, and security best practices in mind (session management, vulnerability prevention, etc.,).
Cloud-Native Development: Familiarity with cloud-native development patterns and tools (e.g., REST APIs, microservices, serverless functions).
Cloud Deployments: Experience deploying and managing containerized applications on Azure/AWS (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instances, or similar).
Version Control (Git): Strong proficiency in Git for effective code collaboration and management.
CI/CD: Knowledge of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices on cloud platforms.
3-5 years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Experience with data processing frameworks like Apache Spark or similar.
Proficiency in SQL and database management systems.
Preferred Skills:
Gen AI Frameworks: Experience with LLM frameworks or tools for interacting with LLMs such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex
Data Pipelines: Experience in setting up data pipelines for model training and real-time inference.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Position Summary
The Cybersecurity Software Lead will join our Software organization to design and implement the cybersecurity features our In Flight Entertainment and Connectivity (IFEC) product suite. The candidate must be a proficient technical leader and have extensive knowledge of cybersecurity of software systems that utilize Android and/or Linux platforms, multi-layered, client-server technologies. Experience in developing complex Java and C/C++ applications on the Android and Linux platform is required. Experience in following cybersecurity features is required: Firewall, Antivirus, Key management, Encryption, SELinux. Candidate must also possess excellent communication skills that will help in the job of leading, and facilitating discussions between stakeholders. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist also has software development responsibilities for prototyping new features. The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will work with SW Architects, SW development teams and system teams.
Essential Functions / Key Areas of Responsibility
The Cybersecurity Software Specialist will provide his technical expertise, guidance, oversight and drive the following:
Drive software architecture Cybersecurity aspects for the IFEC product lines Lead the design of the Cybersecurity features Responsible for Writing the Cybersecurity use cases (user stories), and allocate them to the functional components as necessary Lead the definition of interfaces/APIs between software components Provide the technical expertise and communicate on cybersecurity effectively to other engineers and management via presentations, architecture documents/diagrams, and software requirements Select COTS (Commercial Off the Shelf) and OSS (Open Source Software) for cybersecurity features Assess vulnerabilities of existing COTS and OSS and propose needed updates Analyze existing designs, define and implement security improvements to the existing IFEC designs Must be able to create proof-of-concepts as necessary to demonstrate new ideas/technologies and architectural concepts Participate in detailed design and code reviews for compliance with the defined secured software architecture Ensure the software implementation is in line with the proposed software architecture and recommended design patterns Partner Product and Program Management teams to define and estimate the work scope of new projects and cybersecurity features Responsible for providing technical leadership to junior software engineers in the areas of software design and implementation
Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language
Required Education and Experience:
Area of study: Computer Science
Master degree in field with minimum 6 years of experience
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
OR
Bachelor degree in field with minimum 8 to 10 years of experience in IFE
6+ years of cybersecurity software development experience
Skills:
Expertise in cybersecurity features like Firewall, certificates/key/authentication management, SELinux, Antivirus
Fluent in Java, C, C++, shell scripting, networking protocols, audio video distribution, and database management
Expertise in Android Framework/Internals
Experience with the Linux operating system and SELinux
Experience in software design and development of Android and/or Linux-based systems following an industrial process
Knowledge of the Scrum development process and Continuous Integration practices and tools (e.g. Jenkins, Sonar, GIT, BitBucket, JIRA)
Very good knowledge of all phases of software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, implementation, code review, testing, and release
Self-motivated, critical thinker with strong technical background
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Experience with IFEC systems is a plus

Master degree in Computer Science

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.

We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.

Experience: Freshers can apply.

Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
