Global Employment & Labor Laws Compliance Manager (Advisory)
You are responsible for providing strategic oversight, regulatory assurance, litigation support, and stakeholder governance across employment compliance, statutory remittances, audits, policy implementation, and risk management, while partnering closely with HR, ERM, Legal, C&B, Audit, CISO, Business teams and external partners.
Key Responsibilities:
Employment & Labour Law Compliance:
F Ensure a strategic approach to ongoing compliances w.r.t employment and labour laws across India and Co’s operating entities and countries through structured assessments of data, processes, and policies.
F Identify compliance gaps, assess risks, and drive timely mitigation actions in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
F Maintain oversight of country specific employment compliance requirements and emerging regulatory changes impacting the organization along with country legal and HR leaders.
Statutory Registrations, Filings & Contributions (India)
F Procure, renew, and manage statutory licenses, registrations, and approvals related to employment from appropriate government authorities in India.
F Ensure accurate and timely submission of statutory reports, returns, declarations, and forms under applicable employment laws.
F Oversee remittance of statutory contributions such as ESIC and Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) within defined statutory timelines.
Vendor & Third-Party Employment Compliance
F Lead employment compliance assessments of vendors supporting Facilities Management Group (FMG) and Global Security Group (GSG) across offices in India.
Audits, Inspections & Regulatory Engagement
F Ensure timely availability of accurate, complete, and auditable data for Client audits, Government inspections, External statutory audits, Internal audits and assurance reviews
F Liaise with government authorities during inspections, inquiries, and compliance reviews.
F Participate in conciliation proceedings and represent the organization before labour authorities, tribunals, and courts.
Litigation, Disciplinary & Investigative Support
F Support employment related litigation matters by coordinating documentation, responses, and court submissions in India.
F Conduct and oversee inquiries related to background verification failures and disciplinary investigations.
F Execute absconding processes
Client, Contractual & Business Support
F Respond to employment compliance related information requests from existing and prospective clients.
F Support RFQs, due diligence, and contractual reviews by providing accurate employment compliance inputs and risk assessments.
Policy, SOP & Regulatory Documentation Enablement
F Partner with HR and policy owners to ensure timely updates and publication of employment policies and SOPs in response to regulatory changes and audit observations.
F Facilitate prioritisation, review, and compliance validation of policy and SOP content uploaded on internal knowledge platforms (e.g., The Dot), while working within defined access and ownership frameworks.
F Ensure alignment between documented policies/SOPs and actual operational practices from a compliance standpoint.
Data Privacy, Information Security & Records Governance
F Oversee employment related data privacy and information security compliance, including:
F Access management, Data retention and statutory record maintenance, Regulatory documentation, Privacy notices and consent artefacts
F Breach assessment and response support, Ensure app enrolment compliance in Configuration Management Databases and adherence to contractual data protection provisions.
Risk Management & Business Continuity
F Maintain the GPO risk register, conduct risk assessments, and track mitigation plans.
F Support employment compliance risk assessments for acquired entities as required.

Preferred candidate profile
1. LLB / LLM with a specialization in Labour/Employment Law with Minimum 5 Years of progressive experience in labour laws, employment compliance with a Leading Law Firm or BIG 4
2. Strong exposure to Indian labour legislation; global employment compliance experience is an advantage.
3. Proven experience handling government inspections, audits, conciliation proceedings, and court matters.
4. Experience supporting client audits, RFQs, and contractual compliance reviews.
Stakeholder Management & Key Competencies
Stakeholder Management:
I. Internal: HR, ERM, Legal, Internal Audit, Finance, Business Leaders, GPO Leadership
II. External: Government Authorities, Labour Inspectors, Statutory Bodies, Clients, Auditors, Legal Counsel, Vendors
Key Competencies:
A. Deep expertise in labour and employment laws.
B. Strong regulatory interpretation and risk assessment skills.
C. Ability to engage confidently with government authorities and auditors.
D. High attention to detail and documentation discipline.
E. Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities, holding partners accountable.
F. Ability to operate in high pressure, audit driven environments.
G. Sound judgment, integrity, and confidentiality.
H. Matrixed stake holder engagement with Legal, HR, C&B, ERM, External Partners etc.

SAP BASIS Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

About This Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Software Developer - BMC Helix to join our team and take ownership of the development, integration deployment of BMC Remedy/Helix ITSM applications in enterprise environments. In this role, you will work across the full application lifecycle - from design and development to integration and support - ensuring the platform is aligned with business processes and ITIL best practices. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable ITSM solutions.

What You Will Do

- Develop, configure, and customize BMC Remedy AR System (ARS 8.0+) and BMC Remedy ITSM Suite modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, SRM, SLM, and Knowledge Management
- Manage Foundation Data - including creation, updates, and deletion - and configure ITSM components end-to-end
- Administer Remedy Server and Mid-Tier - covering AR Server, Approval Server, Email Engine, Reporting, and Audit Logging configuration
- Perform installation, upgrades, feature design, development, and data loads for BMC Remedy/Helix applications
- Build and maintain integrations with third-party and B2B systems; lead migrations and consolidation of disparate systems into an enterprise ITSM infrastructure
- Provide technical support across the Remedy Suite - including ADDM, BCM, CMDB, and Asset Management - across production, test, and development environments
- Manage Change Management approvals, assignments, notification mechanisms, SLM, and end-to-end CM lifecycle
- Perform bug fixes, workflow enhancements, and troubleshoot applications at workflow and database levels
- Translate business requirements into application designs using best-practice technical solutions; create and maintain design specifications and architectural diagrams
- Support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

What You Will Bring

- 2- 7 years hands-on development experience with BMC Remedy AR System and BMC/Helix ITSM applications
- Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL
- Strong understanding of third-party and B2B integration architecture with Remedy
- Experience with enterprise migrations and consolidation of ITSM platforms
- Ability to create and maintain architectural diagrams, design specifications, and process documentation
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- End-to-end architecture visibility with the ability to understand application, integration, and infrastructure dependencies
- Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering solutions and resolving issues
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

Develop and release Technical documents in accordance with the company policies/procedures, assuring airworthiness / regulatory requirements are met.
Ensure technical documentation meeting established quality, customer standards, budget and schedule.
Under the Senior Lead Engineer, work in a team environment with multiple participants within AGS TechPubs organization and possible multiple countries (India, US, France).
Gather and analyze the released data technical information from different sources.
Apply the engineering authoring rules.

Must have strong experience within Aerospace industry, Civil Aviation Rules, Aircraft documentation, producing common industry standard technical data, and structured electronic manuals with 8 years to 12 yrs experience
Must be rigorous, organized, autonomous and proactive, and motivated by a position within a multidisciplinary team.
Must have experience of interpreting engineering drawings, software and system level documentation
Must have experience in using and producing documentations at System (AMM, AIPC, MP, IPD, FIM, TSM, AWD etc.) and Product level (CMM, ACMM, CMP etc.).
Must have expertise in the industry standards ATA iSPEC 2200, S1000D, ASD-STE 100
Must have experience of computer skills including the use Microsoft office suite, ERP and Engineering BOM systems
Must have experience of using TechData Editing tools in SGML, XML or other format (ADAM Author, PTC Arbortext, Notepad etc.)
Must have experience of using TechData Managing tools (ADAM Manager or other)

MLOps/DataOps: GitLab, CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, data/model drift

3-8 years in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering or Industrial Analytics.
2+ years delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.

Description:
Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.

Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.

Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Role Name: SAP S/4HANA SD / Vistex / CS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 10 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Sales & Distribution and Customer Service processes.
Configure and implement SAP S/4HANA SD solutions based on business needs.
Design and support Vistex solutions for rebates, chargebacks, incentives, claims, and pricing programs.
Work on Customer Service (CS) processes including service orders, warranty management, and service contracts.
Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, and enhancement projects.
Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including MM, FI, PP, and technical teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support developments, integrations, and interfaces.
Conduct client workshops, provide solution recommendations, and support go-live activities.
Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and project standards.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD).
Mandatory experience in Vistex.
Mandatory experience in SAP Customer Service (CS).
Strong knowledge of:
Order-to-Cash (O2C)
Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs
Minimum one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation project.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Integration knowledge with MM, FI, and other SAP modules.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities: 

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets 
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options 
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring 
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels 
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution 
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts 
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business
AboutCompany: Delhivery Limited is India's largest and fastest-growing fully-integrated logistics services player by revenue as of Fiscal 2021. With its nationwide network covering over 17,000 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.

Description:
About the role:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Car Inspection Engineer to
conduct comprehensive inspections of used cars sourced through dealer partners. The role is
responsible for accurately assessing a vehicle’s mechanical condition, body condition,
structural integrity, and overall quality, while ensuring standardized inspection processes and
transparent reporting.

What You Will Do:
Conduct detailed physical inspections of used cars at dealer locations, customer locations, yards, and designated inspection centers. 
Assess key vehicle systems including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, tyres, steering, electrical systems, AC, and other mechanical components. 
Inspect the exterior and interior condition of vehicles, including body panels, paint quality, dents, scratches, accidental repairs, and signs of structural damage. 
Identify critical vehicle issues such as flood damage, major accidents, odometer tampering, structural damage, and significant mechanical defects. 
Conduct road tests to evaluate vehicle performance, drivability, handling, braking, and overall condition. 
Verify VIN/chassis number, engine number, registration details, and other relevant vehicle documents. 
Use diagnostic tools, inspection equipment, mobile applications, and digital platforms to conduct standardized vehicle assessments. 
Prepare accurate and detailed inspection reports with photographs, observations, identified defects, and recommendations. 
Identify approximate refurbishment/repair costs and clearly highlight major repairs or quality concerns. 
Complete inspections and reports within defined Turnaround Time (TAT). 
Clearly communicate critical defects, major repairs, and vehicle quality concerns to internal teams and dealer stakeholders 
Follow defined inspection SOPs, checklists, quality standards, and safety protocols. 
Maintain accurate inspection records and ensure data quality on the inspection platform/mobile application. 
Identify recurring vehicle quality issues and provide actionable feedback to improve inspection processes, standards, and quality controls. 
What we are looking for:
ITI, Diploma, or Graduate qualification in Automobile Engineering. 
3–5 years of relevant experience as an Automobile Evaluator, Mechanic, Service Advisor, Assistant Service Advisor, or similar role. 
Experience working with passenger vehicles and strong understanding of automotive systems and components. 
Strong multi-brand vehicle technical knowledge. 
Ability to identify accidental damage, mechanical defects, structural issues, and major repair requirements. 
Hands-on experience with vehicle diagnostic tools and inspection applications will be preferred.
Strong attention to detail with excellent observation and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and unbiased inspection reports. 
Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and digital inspection platforms. 
Willingness to travel extensively for vehicle inspections. 
Valid driving licence and practical driving skills preferred. 
What we will give you:
Opportunity to work with modern digital inspection platforms, diagnostic tools, and technology-enabled processes. 
A fast-paced environment where your technical expertise directly influences vehicle quality and business decisions. 
A role with strong ownership, autonomy, and visibility in a growing automotive business. 
A performance-driven environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and career progression. 
At OLX India, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
We embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you are as excited as we are about this position and our company, we hope you join us! To learn more, take a look at our website.
"Our Success is fueled by diverse perspectives and talents."

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Assistant Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 15-20 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 15-20 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.

Importance of documentation in logistics billing and vendor payments.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 30 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 30 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
5+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities

Role: Service Specialist (Travel Based Job)
Company : OYO
Location: Chandigarh

What is this role about?
This role is all about making sure guests have a great stay at OYO hotels.
This is an internship role.

As a Service Specialist, you will regularly visit OYO hotels, work closely with hotel owners and staff, and ensure service quality is maintained. Your work directly impacts guest satisfaction, hotel ratings, and repeat bookings.
This is a field-based role, not a desk job.

Important to know upfront:
You will be required to travel daily and visit around 45 hotels per day within your assigned area.

What will you do in this role?
Guest Experience & Satisfaction:
Check guest feedback, ratings, and reviews regularly
Identify issues faced by guests and take steps to fix them
Work towards improving guest satisfaction and online ratings

Hotel Quality & Operations:
Physically visit hotels to check cleanliness, maintenance, and overall quality
Ensure OYO service and brand standards are followed
Support hotel owners in fixing operational gaps

Staff Training & Support:
Train hotel staff on OYO service standards and guest handling
Help staff understand OYO processes and expectations
Guide them to deliver better service consistently

Coordination & Issue Resolution:
Act as a link between hotel owners and OYO internal teams
Handle guest and hotel escalations calmly and professionally
Ensure faster resolution of issues on the ground

Performance Tracking & Improvement:
Track guest ratings, NPS, and service-related KPIs
Use data and on-ground observations to improve performance

Who can apply?
Graduates (Hospitality background is a plus, not mandatory)
Candidates comfortable with *field work and daily travel*
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple hotels and priorities
Comfortable working on weekends or holidays if required

In simple words:
You will go to hotels every daysupport hotel staff, solve problems, improve service quality, and ensure guests leave happy.

Job Title: Evaluation Engineer
Company: CARS24
Location: Chandigarh/ Ludhiana/ Patiala
Function: Vehicle Inspection/ Evaluation

About CARS24 CARS24 is India's leading pre-owned automobile platform, offering a fast, transparent, and reliable way for customers to buy and sell used cars. The company operates across India, UAE, and Australia.

Role Summary The Evaluation Engineer is responsible for the physical inspection and evaluation of used cars for purchase through retail, auction, or C2C (consumer-to-consumer) transactions ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to CARS24's evaluation standards.

Key Responsibilities
Inspect and evaluate used cars for purchase (retail/auction/C2C) as per assigned leads/appointments.
Conduct thorough vehicle inspections with zero errors, strictly following the company's Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
Assess mechanical condition, cosmetic condition, structural integrity, and overall vehicle health.
Use the CARS24 inspection app/tool to record inspection findings and upload data accurately.
Determine a fair market valuation/price recommendation based on inspection results.
Explain inspection findings and pricing to customers in a clear, professional manner.
Maintain daily visit/inspection targets and ensure timely completion of assigned leads.
Travel to customer locations within and around the assigned city/region for inspections.
Coordinate with the sales/procurement team to close deals.

Requirements
Diploma/ITI/Bachelor's degree in Automobile, Mechanical Engineering, or related field (preferred).
Basic knowledge of vehicle mechanics, engine systems, and car components.
Prior experience in vehicle inspection, automobile service, or a similar field is an advantage.
Valid two-wheeler/four-wheeler driving license.
Candidate should be proficient in driving both two-wheelers and four-wheelers.
Smartphone with willingness to use inspection apps/tools.
Good communication skills (local language + basic Hindi/English).
Willingness to travel locally for field visits.

What CARS24 Offers
Fixed salary with performance incentives.
Structured training and onboarding.
Growth opportunities within procurement/operations.

Description:
Profile Summary

Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Driving Sales and Customer Service

a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually

b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership

d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.

e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.

f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.

h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

Manpower Planning & People Development

a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates

c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.

d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives

e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level

b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage

d. Managing the productivity of the staff

e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory

Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations

a. Regular Store Visits to:


Audit stores

Coaching the Store Managers

Motivate staff through sales discussions

Check VM, stock availability

Check store hygiene, grooming

Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.


b. Analyze data before Store Visits


Monitoring Sales through data.

Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Store Staffing levels.

Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.

NPS and MC scores

Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets


a. Bridge communication between Management and floor


Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

Implement process change

Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets


Inventory Management

a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores

c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level

g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Key Personal and Professional Attributes:

a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.

d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.

e) Extroverted Personality

f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached

g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient

h) Passionate

i) Energetic

j) Positive Attitude

k) Ability to handle stressful situations

l) Problem Solving & Decision Making

m) Assertive

n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player

Candidate Profile:

a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry

b) Post-Graduation is a must

c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator

d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word

e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)

f) Sales oriented

g) Strong Management/leadership skills.

h) Strong organizational skills.

i) Strong team builder

Required Managerial Competencies

People Management

a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.

b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.

c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.

d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner

Proactive Problem Solving Skills

a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.

b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.

c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.

d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation

Commercial Savviness

a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.

b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.

c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints

Customer Expectation Management

a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer

b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests

c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required

Planning and Organizing

a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments

b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches

c) Delegates work effectively among team members

Required Personality Traits

a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves

b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior

c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings

d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern

f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick-
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand

Field Enumerators (15 Posts): Position Summary:
We are seeking dedicated and enthusiastic Field Enumerators to conduct baseline assessments for students in primary schools. The successful candidates will visit schools, interact with children to make them feel comfortable, ask assessment questions, and accurately record their responses using a provided tool. This role requires excellent communication skills, proficiency in English, and the ability to use technology effectively. Prior experience working with primary-grade children is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities:
Visit assigned schools to conduct baseline assessments with students.
Create a welcoming and comfortable environment for children to ensure accurate and honest responses.
Ask assessment questions as per the guidelines and record responses using the designated tool.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of recorded data.
Report any issues or inconsistencies encountered during the assessments to the project supervisor.
Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the data collected.
Adhere to the schedule and complete the assessments within the stipulated timeframe.
Utilize technology tools efficiently to record and manage data.
Communicate effectively with school staff and maintain a professional demeanor at all times.
Qualifications/Requirements:
Must have a two-wheeler to travel to conduct the assessments
Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement.
Proficiency in the local language is required.
Basic knowledge and experience in using tech tools and software.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to make children feel at
ease.
Attention to detail and accuracy in data recording.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Flexibility to travel to various school locations as required.
High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in education, psychology, or a
related field is a plus point.
Functional area:
Chozuba Block, Dist. Phek
Employment type:
Temporary/Contract

450 INR per day + 250 INR Travel allowance

Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
