Description:
Job Details
Department: Creative / Marketing / Production
Reports To: Lead Video Editor / Creative Director / PMO
Location: Northeast India (Travel Required)
Contract Duration: 6 8 Months
Employment Type: Project-Based Contract
Job Summary
We are looking for a creative and digitally savvy Video Editor to join the Creative Team of Hillywood Fiesta. The Video Editor will be responsible for creating engaging video content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other digital platforms, with a strong focus on Reels, short-form videos, promotional content, campaign assets and social-first storytelling. The role requires someone who understands what makes digital content engaging, has a strong sense of visual storytelling and pacing, and can transform raw footage, photographs, interviews, campaign ideas and creative concepts into compelling video content. This is not a production/post-production editing role. The position will primarily support the Creative and Marketing teams in developing digital and social media content.
Organisational Unit Function
The Video Editor will:
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Edit engaging Reels, Shorts and other short-form videos for social media.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Create content optimised for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Convert raw footage and existing content into multiple social media assets.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Identify strong moments, visuals, sound bites and stories that can be turned into engaging digital content.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Create videos with strong hooks, pacing and storytelling designed to capture audience attention.
A. Social Media Short-Form Video Content Adapt videos into different formats, durations and aspect ratios as required by different platforms.
B. Creative Content Development Work with the Creative Team to translate content ideas and concepts into videos.
B. Creative Content Development Participate in brainstorming sessions for social media campaigns, promotional campaigns and digital content.
B. Creative Content Development Suggest video concepts, formats, trends and creative approaches.
B. Creative Content Development Develop creative treatments for Reels and other short-form content.
B. Creative Content Development Experiment with different editing styles, transitions, music, text treatments and visual storytelling techniques.
B. Creative Content Development Stay updated on current social media trends, formats, editing styles and audience behaviour.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Campaign launches.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Event promotions.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Contestant/participant introductions.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Artist and celebrity content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Behind-the-scenes content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Teasers and announcements.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Promotional Reels.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Countdown campaigns.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Sponsor-related content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Interviews and bite-sized content.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Highlights and recap videos.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Festival/event coverage.
C. Promotional Campaign Content Support the development of video assets for Website and digital content.
D. Content Repurposing Repurpose existing videos, interviews, photographs and other creative assets into multiple pieces of content.
D. Content Repurposing Create different versions of content for different platforms.
D. Content Repurposing Identify opportunities to extend the life of existing content through creative editing.
D. Content Repurposing Create short clips from longer interviews or videos.
D. Content Repurposing Turn key campaign messages into visually engaging social content.
E. Creative Collaboration Work closely with the Creative Team to maintain consistency in the visual identity of Hillywood Fiesta.
E. Creative Collaboration Coordinate with the Marketing and Social Media teams to understand the content calendar and campaign requirements.
E. Creative Collaboration Work with Graphic Designers to incorporate visual assets, typography, illustrations and animations into videos.
E. Creative Collaboration Take direction from the Creative Lead while also contributing independent creative ideas.
E. Creative Collaboration Participate in content planning and creative review meetings.
Selection Criteria
We are looking for a creative and proactive Video Editor with strong editing and visual storytelling skills. The candidate should understand short-form social content, current trends, and audience engagement, while being able to work under tight deadlines and collaborate effectively with the Creative and Marketing teams.
Key Deliverables
Instagram Reels
YouTube Shorts
Facebook short-form videos
Promotional videos
Campaign videos
Teasers and announcements
Behind-the-scenes videos
Interview clips
Event and activity highlights
Participant/artist introduction videos
Social media promotional assets
Sponsor-related video content
Other creative video assets required by the Creative and Marketing teams
Required Skills Competencies
Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent.
Strong understanding of Reels, Shorts and other social media video formats.
Good sense of visual storytelling, pacing, music and composition.
Ability to create strong hooks and engaging short-form content.
Basic knowledge of motion graphics, text animation and visual effects.
Good understanding of social media trends and digital audience behaviour.
Strong creative thinking and ability to develop content ideas.
Attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple content requirements.
Experience Qualifications
Essential:
A degree/diploma in Film, Mass Communication, Media, Visual Communication, Graphic Design or a related field is preferred. However, a strong portfolio and practical experience will be given greater importance than formal qualifications.
2 3+ years of experience in video editing and digital content creation.
Proven experience creating Reels, Shorts or other social-first video content.
Strong portfolio/showreel demonstrating creative editing.
Experience working with social media or digital content teams.
Experience Qualifications
Preferred:
Experience in entertainment, media, music, events, lifestyle, advertising or digital content.
Experience creating content for entertainment brands or public personalities.
Experience with motion graphics and basic animation.
Familiarity with Northeast Indian culture, entertainment and digital audiences is an advantage.
Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate is not just an editor but a content creator with strong editing skills. They should understand why people stop scrolling, what makes a Reel engaging, how to build a story within a short duration and how to turn ordinary footage into content that people want to watch and share. They should be creative, fast, trend-aware and proactive, while also being able to work within the brand guidelines and creative direction of Hillywood Fiesta.

Job Description Channel Sales (Nagaland)
Position: Channel Sales Manager / Executive
Location: Nagaland
Experience: 5+ Years
Salary: 5 LPA – 25 LPA
Profile: Target-Based Sales
Industry: Inverter / UPS / CPS / Solar / Lithium Inverter Batteries
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-oriented Channel Sales professional to develop and expand our dealer, distributor, retailer, and channel partner network across Nagaland. The candidate should have strong experience in channel sales and preferably possess an established network in the inverter, UPS, CPS, solar, lithium inverter battery, or related power-electronics industry.

Develop, appoint, and manage dealers, distributors, retailers, and channel partners across Nagaland.
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets through effective channel management.
Drive sales of Inverters, UPS/CPS, Solar Products, Lithium Inverter Batteries, and related products.
Identify new markets, territories, and business opportunities across Nagaland.
Expand market coverage and strengthen the company's channel network.
Maintain strong relationships with existing dealers and distributors.

Generate primary and secondary sales through the channel network.
Handle order generation, follow-ups, collections, and payment coordination.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes, and market trends.
Ensure proper product visibility and market presence at dealer/retailer locations.
Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and territory development plans.
Coordinate with internal teams for stock availability, dispatches, schemes, and customer requirements.

Description:
About Saturday Art Class (SArC):

At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. As a non-profit educational initiative, we embed visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) into the classrooms of India s government and low-income schools-helping children discover their voices and build the skills they need to thrive in life.
Since 2016, SArC has co-created safe and creative spaces with over 90 partners across 13 states , enabling students to engage in art-based learning that nurtures empathy, resilience, and self-awareness. Our digital resources have empowered 1.12 million+ users across 7 countries , reinforcing our commitment to equitable access to creativity and emotional wellbeing.
SArC s journey has been powered by educators, artists, learners, and changemakers who believe in the transformative power of art. Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege- for every child, everywhere.

About Manager, Program Operations [Nagaland]:

As the Manager - State Programs (Nagaland) , you will lead SArC s efforts to strengthen and institutionalise Arts within Nagaland s education system . You will lead government partnerships, state-level advocacy, and program implementation to build greater government ownership and sustainable scale.
You will develop and drive the state strategy, build strategic relationships and alliances, lead the Nagaland team, and use evidence and contextual insights to strengthen programs, influence government priorities, and inform organisational strategy.
This role requires a strategic and execution-oriented leader who can navigate complex government systems, influence senior stakeholders, develop teams, and translate program learning into pathways for long-term institutional change.

Roles Responsibilities
1. Government Partnerships State Leadership
Lead strategic engagement with the Directorate of School Education SCERT, Samagra Shiksha, District Education Offices, and other key government stakeholders, building trusted and sustained relationships.
Represent SArC in government reviews, consultations, planning meetings, and relevant state forums, ensuring effective follow-through on commitments and decisions.
Understand government priorities, systems, decision-making processes, and leadership changes to strengthen partnership continuity and identify strategic opportunities.
Serve as the primary bridge between the Nagaland government ecosystem, the state team, and SArC s central team.
2. State Strategy, Advocacy Institutionalisation
Set the state-level strategic direction for strengthening the role of Arts within Nagaland s education system, identifying priorities, opportunities, and pathways for long-term change.
Lead advocacy and influence efforts to build the case for Arts and shape how government stakeholders understand and prioritise its role within education.
Drive the transition from SArC-led programs to sustainable government ownership, identifying opportunities to embed Arts within existing policies, programmes, curricula, teacher development, and systems.
Anticipate changes and risks in the state ecosystem and adapt the strategy to protect and advance long-term institutionalisation.
3. Program Leadership, Monitoring, Learning Knowledge Building
Provide overall leadership for SArC s programs across Nagaland, ensuring quality, consistency, timely delivery, and alignment with the state strategy.
Oversee implementation across educator training, schools, exhibitions, and district and state-level engagements, using field visits to assess quality and understand on-ground realities.
Work with ME to analyse implementation data, stakeholder feedback, and field insights and translate these into program and strategic improvements.
Ensure key implementation learnings, evidence, case studies, and partnership insights are documented and used to strengthen future programming, advocacy, and scale.
4. Team Leadership Cross-Functional Collaboration
Set clear priorities and delegate effectively, enabling the team to take increasing ownership of implementation and stakeholder engagement.
Work closely with Curriculum, Training, Partnerships, ME, Finance, Operations, and Communications to align state priorities with organisational capabilities.
Bring state-level insights and learning into wider organisational strategy and decision-making.
Qualifications Experience:
5-7 years of experience in program management, government partnerships, education programs, or development sector implementation.
Strong understanding of Nagalands education ecosystem and government systems is highly desirable.
Graduate or postgraduate degree in Education, Public Policy, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Management, or a related field.
Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
Skills and Mindset:
Strategic Leadership Execution: Ability to translate vision into strategy and effective implementation, with strong planning, prioritisation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Government Stakeholder Leadership: Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to engage, influence, and build trust with senior government and institutional stakeholders.
People Leadership Collaboration: Strong people management skills with the ability to develop high-performing teams, delegate effectively, foster ownership, and collaborate across functions.
Adaptability Ownership: High ownership, resilience, and adaptability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate risks, respond to changing contexts, and continuously improve. Willingness to travel extensively across Nagaland.
Other Details:
Location: Kohima, Nagaland, India
Compensation: 6 to 7 LPA
Reporting Manager: Chief Operations Officer.

Description:
Project: Hillywood Fiesta
Reports To: Program Manager/Festival Operations Manager
Location: Northeast India (Travel Required)
Contract Duration: 6-8 Months
Employment Type: Project-Based Contract
Salary Range: Upto 3.6 LPA
Purpose of the Position
The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing all logistical and on-ground operational requirements for Hillywood Fiesta. This includes the online and offline auditions, Bootcamp, production activities, and the Grand Finale. The role ensures that people, equipment, materials, transportation, accommodation, venues, and operational resources are in the right place at the right time, enabling every phase of the project to run efficiently and without disruption. This is a highly operational role that requires exceptional planning, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
Organisational Unit Function
The Logistics Coordinator will:
Plan and coordinate all logistical requirements across the project lifecycle.
Manage travel, accommodation, transportation, and local movement for contestants, judges, mentors, crew, vendors, and guests.
Coordinate venue readiness and ensure all operational requirements are in place before each event.
Oversee movement and delivery of equipment, materials, production assets, and event supplies.
Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, transport providers, hotels, and local service providers.
Develop logistics schedules, movement plans, and operational checklists.
Monitor inventory and ensure all required resources are available on time.
Support site setup, dismantling, and operational readiness during auditions, Bootcamp, and the Grand Finale.
Work closely with Production, Finance, Procurement, and Festival Operations to ensure seamless execution.
Identify logistical risks and prepare contingency plans to minimise disruptions.
Ensure compliance with health, safety, and operational requirements during all project activities.
Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Festival Operations Manager and works closely with the PMO Director, Program Manager, Creative Production Lead, Production Team, and all Mentors and Trainers engaged on the project.
Communications (Internal/External)
PMO Director - Share progress updates and escalate key issues.
Head of Operations - Coordinate logistics and operational planning
Project Coordinator - Align schedules and daily project activities.
Finance Procurement Manager - Process procurement and budget-related requests.
Creative Production Lead - Plan and execute event logistics
Event Coordinator - Plan and execute event logistics
Vendors, Contractors, Hotels, Transport Providers, Venue Partners - Coordinate bookings, deliveries, and operational support.
Selection Criteria
We are looking for someone who thrives behind the scenes and understands that flawless logistics are the backbone of a successful event. The ideal candidate is highly organised, proactive, and capable of anticipating operational challenges before they arise. They should be comfortable managing multiple moving parts simultaneously, coordinating diverse stakeholders, and ensuring that every logistical detail from transport and accommodation to equipment and venue readiness is executed seamlessly. Above all, they should take ownership, communicate effectively, and remain composed under pressure to keep Hillywood Fiesta running smoothly from start to finish.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Event Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
3 5+ years of relevant logistics or operations experience.
Experience in coordinating transportation, accommodation, and venue operations for large-scale events is highly desirable.
Familiarity with project management and logistics tracking tools is an advantage.
Essential
Relevant Logistics or Event Operations Experience Candidates must have prior experience in logistics, operations, hospitality, large-scale events, festivals, productions, conferences, or similar operational environments. Experience managing complex logistical operations involving multiple vendors and stakeholders is essential.
Excellent Planning Coordination Skills Must be capable of managing multiple logistical workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong Communication Skills Professional communication is essential and must communicate effectively with:
Vendors
Hotels
Transport providers
Production teams
Internal departments
Government authorities
Venue management
Contractors
Strong Problem-Solving Ability Must be able to respond quickly to unexpected operational issues such as transportation delays, accommodation changes, weather disruptions, equipment failures, or schedule adjustments.
Ability to Work Under Pressure The candidate must remain calm, organised, and solution-oriented during live operations and changing project conditions.
Willingness to Travel Must be willing to travel extensively across the Northeast throughout the auditions, Bootcamp, and Grand Finale.
Flexible Working Hours Must be available to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during critical phases of the project.
Professionalism Accountability Must consistently demonstrate:
Reliability
Ownership
Integrity
Accountability
Punctuality
Teamwork
Strong work ethic

4. Strong knowledge of merchant onboarding, incentives, and field sales operations
5. Experience in POS/EDC device sales will be preferred
6. Familiar with metrics-based sales tracking and incentive planning

Graduate (mandatory); Post-Graduation preferred

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies

Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.

Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.

Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Purpose
To lead and manage all store operations within the cement plant, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, preservation, inventory control, and issuance of materials, spare parts, consumables, and capital items. The role is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing stock levels, supporting uninterrupted plant operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and audit requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Store Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day store activities including receipt, inspection, storage, preservation, and issue of materials.
Ensure systematic storage and identification of all inventory items.
Implement best practices in warehouse and store management.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards within store premises.
2. Inventory Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure availability of critical spares and consumables.
Optimize stock holdings to balance operational requirements and inventory carrying costs.
Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counting, and annual physical inventory.
Analyze slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete, and surplus inventory and recommend corrective actions.
3. Material Receipt & Dispatch
Ensure timely receipt and documentation of incoming materials.
Coordinate with procurement, quality, and user departments for material inspection and acceptance.
Manage material issuance as per approved procedures and authorization matrix.
Monitor transportation and dispatch activities where applicable.
4. ERP & Documentation Control
Ensure accurate and timely transactions in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/other ERP platforms).
Maintain inventory records, stock registers, material movement records, and statutory documents.
Generate periodic MIS reports related to inventory, stock valuation, consumption trends, and KPI performance.
5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Liaise with procurement, maintenance, production, finance, and project teams for material planning and availability.
Support plant shutdowns, overhauls, and project activities through effective material management.
Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners regarding deliveries and material discrepancies.
6. Compliance, Audit & Governance
Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
Facilitate internal, external, and statutory audits.
Implement inventory control procedures to prevent losses, pilferage, and material deterioration.
Ensure adherence to ISO, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
7. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop store personnel.
Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence within the stores function.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

AboutCompany:
Woodland Hospital is a Multi-Specialty Hospital situated at the heart of the city at Dhankheti, Shillong which was established in 21st March 1991 as a Proprietary concern. Considering the paucity of standard medical facilities available in the state, Dr. W. Kharshiing and his wife Mrs. Margret Wahlang decided to start a Nursing Home offering better alternatives to the patients of the medically deficient state. It was such a dream that few may have been imagined to see in its present form.
The hospital was started with 28 Indoor beds, two Operation Theatres viz; One Major & One Minor, along with the very basic Diagnostic facilities likes: Pathology, X-Ray, Ultra-Sonography etc. The Departments were limited to General Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics and ENT. During the year 1994, the hospital was expanded to 56 bed capacity. The New Operation Theatre Complex, a CT Scan Machine and four bedded Intensive Care Unit were also added to meet the increasing demands of the people. The CT scan was the first one the State had ever seen in1995.
The hospital went on to Expand to 120 beds during the year 2001 with the addition of an annexed building. Woodland Hospital has always strived to introduce the latest advancements of medical technology and it introduced the Medical Resonance Imaging (MRI) the first one in the state in 2002. At present the hospital expanded to 160 beds with the addition of another annexed building in 2013. The Hospital is the only Hospital in the state which is well equipped with the ultra modern facilities.
In 2006 the Department of Pathology has been accredited by the National Accreditation Board for Testing & Calibration Laboratories (NABL) for Medical Testing and has been given the Certificate Number M-0213 in accordance with the ISO 15189:2007. The Department of Pathology of the Hospital is the first one in the entire state and the only fourth institution in the entire North East India to be accredited in the field of Medical Blood Testing by NABL at that point of time. This stature is not only the recognition of our expertise in the field for the past works done but is also the boost for the Department of Pathology to continue doing the same for ever. Woodland Hospital, Shillong is also NABH pre accredited.
On 15th September 2020, Woodland WK Hospital was inaugurated at Jowai in West Jaintia Hills District of Meghalaya. It is a 100 bedded Multispecialty Hospital having General beds, Semi-private beds and Single rooms. It is equipped with 14 I.C.U beds and 6 Neonatal I.C.U beds. It also has 3 Operation Theatres, 12 Dialysis beds, Endoscopy, X-Ray, CT- Scan, U.S.G, Department of Pathology and Department of Microbiology. Other services include O.P.D and I.P.D and round the clock Emergency Services. All Doctors quarters are within the Hospital premises.
Our other diagnostics centres are Woodland Medical Centre, Ladthalaboh, Jowai, Bell View Diagnostic Clinic, Mawkhar, Shillong, Woodland Diagnostic Centre, Nongkseh, Upper Shillong and Woodland Institute of Nursing, Latikor, Shillong

ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Title Store Manager

Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About Lenskart

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder

People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.

You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc .

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Responsible for building rates, packages and hotel sales strategy information in the hotel(s) inventory systems

- Participates in periodic regional reviews
- Promotes and protects brand equity.

- Acts as a liaison, when necessary, between property and regional/corporate systems support.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Manufacturing Engineer to optimize production processes, improve manufacturing efficiency, and ensure high-quality product output. The ideal candidate will work closely with production, quality, maintenance, and design teams to implement process improvements, reduce costs, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes to improve productivity and quality.
Analyze production workflows and identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction.
Design and implement tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing methods.
Prepare and maintain process documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Troubleshoot production issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Coordinate with design, quality, procurement, and production teams to ensure smooth product manufacturing.
Conduct time studies and capacity planning to improve operational efficiency.
Support new product introduction (NPI) and process validation activities.
Monitor key manufacturing metrics and recommend improvements.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.
Participate in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
22 years of experience in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, and quality systems.
Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar) is preferred.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems is an advantage.
Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.

Purpose/Objective


This role is responsible to manage the shift operations within the thermal power plant, ensuring operational efficiency, safety, and compliance with all procedures and regulations.
This role will manage the operations of all units, switchyard, and Balance of Plant (BoP), and coordinate with various stakeholders to optimize plant performance.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Section Head - Shift In-charge (Plant Operations) Operational Management and Efficiency: Monitor operations of thermal power plant, switchyard, and Balance of Plant with optimum efficiency.
Monitor plant operations and handle emergencies including shut-down of units and load throw-off to control generation as per requirements.
Monitor DSM (Deviation Settlement Mechanism) and operations of all units to reduce DSM loss.
Report shift activities in E-Log books and ensure all documents are being filled by the shift team.
Safety and Permit to Work System: Monitor issuance and cancellation of Permit as per PTW systems.
Track and manage availability of emergency equipment and firefighting systems.
Manage emergency equipment trials and restoration of process and equipment.
Coordination and Communication: Monitor loading of machines, switchyard equipment, and ensuring coordination with LDC, NLDC, and SLDC.
Instructions to desk and field operators for safe operations.
Coordinate with all internal stakeholders for ensuring smooth operations.
Escalate plant operations-related problems events to the Section Head.
Maintenance and Emergency Response: Follow up with maintenance departments for defect resolutions.
Ensure routine operational activities such as the lineup of the unit and its auxiliaries, changeover of equipment, routine testing of protection and annunciation systems during the shift.
Support in recommissioning of units after AOH and COH.
Monitor Unit wise operations and handling emergencies including load throw off, unit tripping, equipment tripping, and generation loss.
Business Sustainability: Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA, CHETNA guidelines within the department.
Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
Digitization and Automation: Lead and execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency.
Review and implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
People and Team Engagement: Drive and enhance employee engagement and retention across the team to sustain a positive workplace culture.
Lead, inspire, and mentor the team to foster a high-performance culture and ensure cross-skilling through job rotation, technical and behavioral training.
Development of subordinates and inputs on TNI ensure proper training.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: All departments Key Stakeholders - External: Vendors SLDC
Technical Competencies


Auxiliary Power Management-APL,Emergency Response and Incident Management-APL,Inventory and Spares Parts Management-APL,Performance and Root Cause Analysis-APL,Plant Operations Management-APL,Process Optimization-APL,Regulatory Compliance-APL,Safety Management-APL
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: BE/B.
tech in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.
Work Experience (Range of years): Minimum of 18+ years of experience in power plant operations with a focus on thermal power plants Preferred Industry: Experience in the power generation industry, specifically with thermal power plants, is highly preferred.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


This role is responsible for managing all aspects of railway yard operations, including the maintenance of locomotives, signalling systems, and wagon conditions to ensure efficient and uninterrupted operations.
They manage the reception and unloading of coal rakes, maintain communication systems, and enforce safety and environmental standards within the railway yard.
Additionally, the role involves meticulous documentation and reporting, as well as implementing digitization and automation initiatives to optimize operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities of Role


Shift In charge - Railway Operation Operational Excellence: Manage railway yard operations, including locomotive parameters and the operation of electrical and manual hand points, in coordination with the shift team.
Manage signalling system operations within the yard panel alongside the panel master and supervise the unloading of laden coal rakes.
Monitor wagon conditions, including side panels, doors, PU pads, and coupling handles, as well as the operation of bulge wagon sensing devices, yard hooters, and local annunciators during shunting to ensure uninterrupted tippling operations.
Communicate with the Assistant Yard Master (AYM) to coordinate the proper shunting of rakes and bulge wagons, and manage the shunting and positioning of wagons at the track hopper.
Facilitate coordination between the locomotive pointsman and the locomotive pilot, as well as the field pointsman, to ensure efficient shunting operations.
Operational Efficiency and Safety: Ensure the functionality and operational readiness of walkie-talkies and their batteries for communication with the yard panel master, AYM, loco pilot, porter, and shunt man.
Conduct regular inspections of points conditions in coordination with the loco pilot and AYM, and monitor the timely placement of rakes, wagon brake release, brake pressure pipe opening, and coupling conditions.
Verify the correct positioning of guard wagons and isolated wagons to prevent unexpected shunting incidents.
Maintain the condition of points, tongue rails, and stock rails.
Manage communication systems to guarantee effective functioning with fields and points.
Rake Handling and Environmental Maintenance: Execute the unloading of bottom ash hoppers, economizer hoppers, and ESP hoppers, ensuring area cleanliness to meet environmental standards.
Optimize rake unloading times and the formation of empty rakes to minimize the risk of incurring demurrage charges.
Supervise the proper unloading of rakes, brake pipe connections, and coupling of empty wagons, ensuring compliance with safety standards and procedures.
Perform routine cleaning of track lines and control panels to ensure operational efficiency.
Manage the refuelling of locomotive diesel as necessary to sustain rake operations.
Railway Yard Management and Rake Unloading: Handle the management of Domestic, Imported, and GPWIS rakes to facilitate smooth coal rake unloading.
Ensure the proper reception of coal-laden rakes and dispatch of empty rakes, report any missing or additional wagons, and oversee the cleaning of residual coal from the rake bottoms.
Monitor unloaded rakes in the post-tippling area, checking the tightness and locking condition of doors.
Uphold housekeeping standards in the Railway yard, New railway yard, and loco shed to ensure a safe working environment.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain logbooks and log sheets at the Railway Siding for precise record-keeping.
Generate Management Information System (MIS) reports on Railway activities and performance.
Implement safe isolation of railway siding track lines during emergencies.
Issue Permits to Work (PTW) as necessary.
Business Sustainability: Implement and follow to IMS, AWMS, DISHA, and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
Conduct regular safety training and enforce safety protocols to protect personnel and equipment.
Promote a culture of environmental responsibility and sustainability in Railway siding.
Implement strategies to reduce waste and enhance resource conservation.
Provide information and necessary support during regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
Digitization and Automation: Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency.
Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy.
Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
Key Stakeholders - Internal: CHP Security Admin IT BD team Chemistry Techno Commercial Stores Key Stakeholders - External: Indian Railway Contractors
Technical Competencies


Coal Transportation and Logistics-APL,Compliance, Audit, and Safety Management-APL,Housekeeping and Yard Maintenance-APL,IPFM Emergency Response and Risk Management-APL,Liaisoning-APL,Process Optimization-APL,Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)-APL
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification: BE/B.
tech in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Work Experience (Range of years): 4+ years of experience in power plant operations or similar industrial settings.
Preferred Industry: Power generation, specifically in operations or maintenance of Coal Rake handling systems.

It has created a world class transport and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its transport logistics and energy utility portfolio businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India./n/nAdani owes its success and leadership position to its core philosophy of 'Nation Building' driven by 'Growth with Goodness' - a guiding principle for sustainable growth. Adani is committed to increase its ESG footprint by realigning its businesses with emphasis on climate protection and increasing community outreach through its CSR programme based on the principles of sustainability, diversity and shared values.

Description:
Purpose/Objective


The Project Management & Control Specialist will play a pivotal role within Adani's Thermal Projects division, based in Raipur.
This role demands a dynamic and experienced professional capable of leading complex thermal power projects through all phases of their lifecycle, from planning and execution to monitoring and closure.
The ideal candidate will embody Adani’s culture of innovation, integrity, and operational excellence, driving projects efficiently while fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to one of India’s leading energy conglomerates, delivering sustainable power solutions that impact millions of lives.
