Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Description: Client Relationship Executive
Company Name: MB Sons Jewellers
Position Title: Client Relationship Executive
Department: Client Relations / Customer Experience
Location: On-site (Showroom)
Employment Type: Full-time
About MB Sons Jewellers
MB Sons Jewellers is renowned for exquisite craftsmanship, timeless luxury, and an unyielding commitment to trust and excellence. We pride ourselves on creating memorable luxury shopping experiences and building lifelong relationships with our valued patrons.
Job Summary
We are looking for an eloquent, warm, and sophisticated Client Relationship Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary ambassador for our brand, focusing exclusively on high-touch client interaction, customer engagement, and relationship management. In this role, you will elevate the showroom experience, maintain personalized engagement with our esteemed clientele, and ensure every patron feels valued and cherished.
Key Responsibilities (Focused on Client Interaction)
High-Touch Client Engagement: Warmly welcome high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and walk-in clients, ensuring an inviting, luxurious, and hospitable atmosphere.
Personalized Consultation: Listen actively to clients' preferences, style choices, and occasions (weddings, anniversaries, corporate gifting) to assist them through their high-end jewellery selection process.
Relationship Building & Retention: Maintain a detailed client portfolio; follow up with clients post-purchase, celebrate special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries), and extend exclusive event invitations.
Brand Representation: Communicate the story, heritage, and unique craftsmanship of MB Sons Jewellers with passion, elegance, and in-depth product knowledge.
Client Advisory: Offer tailored advice on custom jewellery inquiries, bespoke orders, and maintenance/care services.
Feedback & Service Excellence: Act as the direct touchpoint for client feedback and ensure any service queries or special requests are addressed with utmost care and promptness.
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience: 13+ years of experience in client-facing roles, high-end retail, hospitality, or luxury customer service (Experience in fine jewellery/luxury lifestyle brands is a strong plus).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal communication and interpersonal skills with an articulate, polite, and refined demeanor.
Languages: Proficiency in English and local languages (Hindi/regional language fluency required).
Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and crafting memorable client journeys.
Grooming & Presentation: Immaculate personal presentation and grooming consistent with a luxury brand environment.
Key Competencies
Active Listening & Empathy
Polished Interpersonal & Networking Skills
Warm, Welcoming, and Professional Demeanor
High Emotional Intelligence (EQ) and Tact
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
Opportunity to represent a premier luxury jewellery brand.
Professional growth and long-term career advancement in high-end retail management.
A vibrant, luxurious, and supportive working environment.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Our advice and products are focused, fact-based, relevant and improve employee experience in moments that matter. We shape Deutsche Banks working environment to enable our people to be the best they can be for our clients, the bank and society.
Overview
As the HR Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the people strategy for Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB) Operations Controls divisions in India, and drive HR initiatives to support business objectives. You will partner closely with senior leadership to provide both strategic and operational HR leadership for the identified divisions in the country.
Core expectations of this role are:
Functional leadership and partnership across HR
Governance, controls, and culture of excellence
Business partnership, ownership and accountability
Team / People leadership
Your key responsibilities
Implementation of HR s people strategy in partnership with Global, Divisional and Regional HR leadership
Provide HR functional leadership by fostering strong partnership, collaboration and engagement with the broader HR function, including regional and global stakeholders across business partner, product, country teams and process owners to deliver relevant HR solutions
Establish strong HR business partnerships by building trusted advisor relationships with regional and local stakeholders, providing independent HR guidance and advice, and taking ownership and accountability for all HR delivery and activities in India
Strengthen leadership effectiveness and build a robust talent pipeline for key senior roles in India
Create a positive and inclusive workplace culture that promotes employee engagement and retention
Drive global HR processes such as year-end compensation and promotion cycles and talent management, ensuring fair and consistent decisions with appropriate business management governance and ownership
Use key qualitative and quantitative metrics to inform decision-making and HR strategies
Implement diversity initiatives to raise awareness and improve gender diversity and inclusion
Participate in senior leadership team meetings, consulting on HR topics including leadership, policies and practices, diversity and inclusion, and talent management
Provide people leadership by fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning and feedback, sharing best practices, and actively supporting the development of the HR team
Your skills and experience
MBA (HR) with a minimum of 10+ years of HR domain experience, including strong knowledge of HR policies, products and processes
At least 3 5 years of experience within the Banking sector
Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building and communication skills
Experience working in a complex, multicultural, matrix organisation
Ability to operate independently and objectively to achieve the right people outcomes for the franchise
Solutions-oriented with an innovative mindset
Strong HR background with demonstrable business acumen and commercial understanding
Comfortable presenting to senior management groups, with the ability to produce concise, data-backed presentations and conduct necessary research and inquiry

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

New Business Acquisition
Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular

PTL freight movement needs.
Run the full sales cycle: prospecting, cold outreach, discovery calls, site visits, commercial proposals, and deal closure.
Focus on accounts with 50500 MT/month PTL potential across (but not restricted to) sectors such as FMCG, Auto-Components, Pharma, and Industrial Goods.

Revenue & Target Ownership
Own a monthly revenue target for your assigned territory and be accountable for delivery against it every billing cycle.

Client Engagement & Retention

Identify upsell opportunities — such as dedicated lane commitments, cross-dock usage, or value-added services — within the first 90 days of account activation.

Market Intelligence & Reporting
Map the competitive surface freight landscape in your territory — identify accounts held direct competition or regional players.
Share weekly market feedback on competitor pricing, new product launches, or shifts in client freight patterns with the regional BD head.

About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Location: RIICO Mansarovar, Jaipur
About Us:
We are a fast-growing, dynamic clothing brand dedicated to trending fashion, unique designs. As we continue to expand our online presence, we're seeking a talented and passionate Performance Marketing/Google & Meta Ads Specialist to help us reach new audiences and drive sales growth.
The Role:
We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing/ Google & Meta Ads Specialist who understands the unique challenges and opportunities of e-commerce, specifically within the fashion industry. You will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive performance marketing strategy to drive qualified traffic to our website and boost sales.
Responsibilities:
Run Google and Meta Ads campaigns to deliver consistently high ROAS and drive sales on our Shopify platforms
Develop and execute a robust SEO strategy for our e-commerce store, including on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify high-value opportunities related to our products and brand.
Optimize product pages, category pages, and blog content for search engines and user experience.
Perform regular technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues such as broken links, crawl errors, and site speed problems.
Manage and execute link-building campaigns to improve our domain authority.
Analyze and report on key SEO metrics (traffic, rankings, conversions, etc.) using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and others.
Stay up-to-date with the latest SEO, GEO, AIO and AEO trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.
Collaborate with the marketing, content, and e-commerce teams to ensure SEO is integrated into all online initiatives.

Requirements:
Proven experience as a Perofrmance Marketing and SEO Specialist, preferably within the e-commerce or fashion industry.
Experience of running Meta and Google Ads that deliver high ROAS
Strong understanding of SEO principles, including on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
Proficiency with SEO tools (e.g.,Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console).
Experience with keyword research and competitive analysis.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and website architecture as it relates to SEO.
Excellent analytical skills and the ability to interpret data to make informed decisions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
A passion for the fashion industry and a creative mindset.

Bonus Points:
Experience with a Shopify or similar e-commerce platform.
Familiarity with content management systems (CMS).
Experience with PPC or other digital marketing channels.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary based on experience. The range for this role is INR 20,000 to INR 25,000 per month plus sales-based incentives.
Opportunity for growth and professional development.
A creative and supportive work environment.
Employee discounts on all our products.

Who need NOT apply:
Candidates looking for freelance opportunities or work from home
Candidates seeking jobs but unwilling to appear for interviews
Performance marketing agencies need not contact via Indeed

Job Type: Full-time

Ability to commute/relocate:
Mansarovar, Jaipur, Rajasthan: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)
Application essentials:
This role is NOT a freelance or work from home position. You must be willing to work full time from our office.

Experience:
Meta and Google Ads: 2 years (Preferred)

Description:
Role Description
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements, and facilitate the exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation, and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA, and US regions.

Core Functional Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of contact for external clients on valuation and collateral-related matters, ensuring timely resolution of queries, disputes, and escalations.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with Front Office, Trading, Sales, Product Control, Middle Office, Risk, and Operations teams globally.
Manage complex valuation and collateral disputes through effective stakeholder engagement and root cause analysis.
Partner with regional and global teams to drive consistency in processes, controls, and operating standards.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks while ensuring adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Monitor and analyze key operational metrics, KPIs, and KRIs to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
Lead process re-engineering, automation, and transformation initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and control effectiveness.
Contribute to strategic and tactical global projects, including platform enhancements, regulatory initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
Provide timely updates to senior management on key risks, escalations, and business-critical issues.

Required Technical & Business Expertise
Strong understanding of valuation, collateral management, margin processes, and dispute management across OTC derivatives and cleared products.
Hands-on experience with AcadiaSoft and TriResolve.
Knowledge of collateral optimization, reconciliation processes, and exception management.
Experience utilizing analytical and reporting tools such as Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of operational risk frameworks, controls, audit requirements, and governance practices.

Leadership & People Management Skills
Proven experience managing, developing, and motivating teams in a fast-paced operational environment.
Ability to coach and mentor team members, providing regular performance feedback and development guidance.
Demonstrated capability in talent management, succession planning, and building high-performing teams.
Ability to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Experience managing team capacity, prioritization, and workload allocation across multiple deliverables.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority.
Effective conflict resolution and escalation management capabilities.
Ability to lead teams through change, transformation, and process optimization initiatives.
Strong focus on employee engagement, learning, and professional development.

Key Competencies
Client-centric mindset with excellent relationship management skills.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability.
Ability to operate independently and make sound decisions under pressure.
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills.
Strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus.
Ability to navigate a highly regulated and dynamic environment.
Collaborative leadership style with a track record of driving results across global teams.

Ideal Target Candidates
Look for candidates currently working as:
AVP / Senior Associate in Collateral Management, Valuations, Margin Operations, or OTC Operations.
Team Leads managing valuation disputes or collateral operations functions.
Professionals with experience in Investment Banks, Prime Brokerage, or Derivatives Operations teams.
Candidates who have led automation, control enhancement, audit remediation, or transformational initiatives alongside day-to-day operational management.
Candidates who have experience in managing a team
With diverse understanding and culture.
A fast-paced operational environment
Able to support the team over high volumes, escalations and issues.

You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from
a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

This is a leadership role where you will own the technology, maintenance, process and setting for the equipment for the line. You will possess deep expertise and will be viewed as the technology expert of the line/s.

How you will contribute

You will:
Partner & enable the line leader(s) to deliver the SQCDSM targets-Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability & Morale for the lines, to ensure Process stability; Participate in the DMS- Daily Management systems meetings at the shift and line level
Own the technology and process and centerline settings for the equipment and process and has deep technical mastery of the process and equipment; own the Progressive maintenance systems and work processes and the Progressive Maintenance Key Performance Indicators for the line/s along with Centerline Management systems; owns the Repairs & Maintenance budget of the line
Develop, own and execute the line/s preventive and time-based maintenance systems and plans and builds capability of the team to execute themselves; Build (spends at least 50% of time) technical and maintenance skills of the technicians working in the shifts, so that they are able to operate and maintain their equipment themselves; be part of the PM Pillar, own all PM systems and work process at the line level and lead some of them at the department level
Partner with the Asset and Reliability team for system improvement and execution of special maintenance tasks; be responsible for Change Management on the line/s, localization of spares and proper break-down analysis and R&M cost reduction for the line/s; represent the department/line/s as the site technology owner in the regional and global technology forums
Assist in VSU for the new initiatives and enables the VSU team; help the line leader in internal and external benchmarking and reapplication; be the subject matter expert on one of the component categories and will be a trainer of PM related subjects for the plant


What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Advanced knowledge (including AM-Autonomous Maintenance Step 4 systems & Progressive Maintenance Step 3) & skill to maintain the dedicated equipment(s)at basic conditions independently, including the execution of AM & PM (BD-Breakdown maintenance, planned maintenance) standards on dedicated equipment(s) and TPM - Phase 3 & 4 tools problem solving tools.
The capability to lead a Role for the Line. Qualify and coach the next level SWP owners and drive the common opportunity areas across the line in PDCA-Plan Do Check Adjust approach
The capability to work as the Line Leader, developing and aligning goal/master plan for the line, deploying and managing IDP for the members, coaching team members on their performance management and career development
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Job Title: Area Sales Manager - Construction Chemicals
Reports To: State/Divisional Head

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Area Sales Manager to drive sales performance and growth for our construction chemicals product line for AP. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and achieving sales targets, expanding distribution networks. This role requires a strong leadership presence, industry knowledge, and a proactive approach to market trends.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Leadership & Target Achievement:
Lead and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel to meet or exceed sales volume, value, and growth targets for the depot.
Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve both short- and long-term goals.
Market & Competitor Analysis:
Monitor and analyze competitor activities, market trends, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for growth and adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion:
Expand and manage a robust retail distribution network within the territory to increase market reach and product availability.
Implement and oversee network management programs to optimize distribution performance.
Customer Relationship Management:
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and partners.
Address customer inquiries and concerns promptly to ensure high satisfaction levels and repeat business.

Education & Experience Requirements:
Education:
Bachelors degree (Graduation) or an MBA (specialization in Marketing preferred).
Experience:
10 to 12 years of proven sales experience in the construction chemicals industry, with a focus on channel sales and distribution.
Demonstrated ability to manage a sales team and deliver measurable results in a competitive market.

Key Skills & Personal Traits:
Communication:
Proficiency in the local language and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Leadership & Management:
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, and manage a team of sales professionals.
Results-driven, achievement-oriented with excellent managerial capabilities.
Customer-Centric:
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain positive customer relationships.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:
Solid analytical abilities to assess sales data, market conditions, and performance metrics.
Proactive in identifying challenges and implementing solutions.
Team Player:
A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively as part of a team, both within the depot and with other departments.
Additional Information:
This role requires travel within the assigned territory, and flexibility to work extended hours when required.
Competitive salary package with performance-based incentives.

Diploma/B.Tech / B.E. degree from a recognized institution.
Strong understanding of industrial equipment operation principles and ability to apply problem-solving skills to resolve complex issues.

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Position: Van FE (Field Executive)
Department: Operations / Last Mile

Roles & Responsibilities:
Ensure timely pickup and delivery of shipments within the assigned route and service area.
Collect shipments from customers/sellers and deliver them safely to the assigned destination.
Perform shipment scanning and status updates through the required mobile application.
Verify shipment details, customer address, and delivery instructions before completing deliveries.
Ensure proper handling of COD collections and follow the companys cash-handling process.
Maintain shipment safety and minimize loss, damage, misrouting, and delivery errors.
Coordinate with customers and provide professional service during pickup and delivery.
Achieve assigned daily productivity, SLA/TAT, and delivery targets.
Report failed deliveries, address issues, customer concerns, and other operational challenges to the concerned team.
Maintain the assigned vehicle and follow all road safety, company SOPs, and compliance requirements.

Primary Purpose of Job:
Contribute to the ongoing growth of Stantec ResourceNet Private India Ltd by providing technical expertise in specialist areas of wastewater network modelling. To be involved in the implementation and delivery of leading edge programmes and projects.
Support project managers/team leader by providing technical expertise to ensure that project outcomes in terms of profit, schedule, technical and quality standards, meet both the client and Stantec expectations.
Key Accountabilities:
Wastewater/stormwater hydraulic modelling
Model build and verification
Optioneering & Outline Design of hydraulic solutions
Development Impact Assessment
Preparation of technical reports / drawings,
Working with GIS databases,
Handling and managing large data sets for analysis
Carry out other duties as may be assigned from time to time by supervisor/management,

Need to travel off-shore for training/on-site work: Occasionally

Bachelors/Masters degree in civil/ Environmental Engineering
Expert in hydraulic modelling, run-off models and hydraulics (gravity & pressure networks), Optioneering & Outline Design of hydraulic solutions
Expert in hydraulic modelling software, InfoWorks CS, InfoWorks ICM. In addition to this candidate with experience in Mike Urban, TUFLOW, HECRAS 2D and SWMM will be preferred
Have excellent data manipulation abilities (FME/POWERBI/MS Excel/MS Access database type packages)
Good skills in GIS packages: Mapinfo, ArcGIS preferred
Expert in Technical report writing skills
Good level of client service management, i.e. able to interface with clients and to build and maintain lasting, positive relationships with our Clients
Capable to analyse, assess, evaluate the issues, complexity pertaining to projects / work packages and support the team lead in mitigating them in advance
Rigorous attention to detail, able to understand and adopt workflows and commitment to personal professional development
Competent level of baseline skills, i.e. professional and confident with the essential, basic business and communication skills that are required for career growth in all positions
Flexible attitude to accepting different work assignments and pro-active attitude to execution / delivery

Job Summary
Job Purpose
To independently manage and execute day-to-day finished goods dispatch operations, ensuring 100% dispatch accuracy, timely vehicle placement, proper documentation, inventory accuracy, and adherence to safety and statutory requirements. The role will coordinate with PPC, Production, Sales, Warehouse, Transporters, Finance, and customers to achieve the dispatch plan.
Key Responsibilities
Dispatch Planning Execution Execute the daily and monthly dispatch plan in line with customer and business requirements. Coordinate with PPC and Finished Goods Store for product availability and dispatch readiness. Prioritize customer-critical, ageing, and urgent dispatches. Monitor planned vs. actual dispatch on a daily basis. Identify bottlenecks and take corrective action to achieve dispatch targets. Ensure timely dispatch closure in SAP/ERP.
Vehicle Transporter Management Coordinate with logistics/transporters for timely vehicle placement. Prepare and monitor the day-wise vehicle requirement and loading plan. Ensure appropriate vehicle type and capacity for the planned load. Monitor vehicle reporting, loading, documentation, and departure. Minimize vehicle detention and improve vehicle turnaround time. Escalate vehicle shortages and delays to the concerned stakeholders.
SAP / ERP Documentation Process dispatch transactions accurately in SAP/ERP. Generate and verify OBD, picking documents, invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, and other applicable documents. Ensure physical material, SAP stock, invoice, and dispatch quantity are matched before vehicle release. Maintain proper system and document traceability. Resolve SAP-related dispatch issues in coordination with PPC/IT/Finance.
Finished Goods Inventory Control Ensure correct model, quantity, customer, destination, and packaging before loading. Maintain accurate FG inventory and dispatch records. Reconcile physical stock with SAP stock. Identify and report stock discrepancies immediately. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end physical inventory verification. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable. Control ageing and slow-moving finished goods through proper dispatch prioritization.
Loading Material Handling Supervise loading to ensure safe and damage-free handling of finished goods. Ensure proper product identification and loading sequence. Verify loading quantity against invoice/OBD. Ensure proper vehicle loading, stacking, lashing, and protection. Coordinate with MHE operators and loading manpower. Ensure compliance with plant EHS and material-handling procedures.
Team Shift Coordination Guide and monitor dispatch executives, operators, loaders, and contract manpower. Allocate manpower based on daily dispatch requirements. Ensure effective utilization of loading docks, MHE, and dispatch area. Monitor shift-wise dispatch performance. Train team members on SOPs, SAP transactions, safety, and documentation.
Coordination with Internal External Stakeholders Coordinate closely with: PPC Production Finished Goods Store Sales Customer Service Logistics / Transporters Finance Commercial Quality Security Warehouse / Distribution Centres Resolve dispatch-related issues on priority. Provide regular status updates to management.
MIS Performance Reporting Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly reports covering: Dispatch plan vs. actual Customer/warehouse-wise dispatch Vehicle placement status Pending dispatch Vehicle turnaround time FG stock Ageing stock Loading productivity Dispatch shortages/delays Dispatch-related complaints Key KPIs / KRAs KPI Key Measure Dispatch Plan Achievement = 100% of approved plan On-Time Dispatch % dispatch within committed timeline Dispatch Accuracy Model/quantity/customer/document accuracy Vehicle Placement % vehicles placed as per plan Vehicle TAT Reduction in loading detention time Inventory Accuracy Physical vs. SAP accuracy

Purpose/Objective


The First Class Mines Manager will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and statutory operation of limestone/mineral mines.
The incumbent will ensure compliance with mining regulations, achieve production targets, manage resources effectively, and drive operational excellence while maintaining the highest safety standards.
Key Responsibilities of Role


a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } Mine Operations Management - Plan, organize, and supervise day-to-day mining operations.
- Ensure achievement of monthly and annual production targets.
- Monitor drilling, blasting, excavation, loading, and transportation activities.
- Optimize mine productivity and equipment utilization.
Safety & Compliance - Ensure compliance with the Mines Act, DGMS regulations, MMR, and other statutory requirements.
- Implement and monitor safety management systems and safe work practices.
- Conduct safety inspections, audits, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
- Investigate accidents/incidents and implement corrective actions.
Resource & Team Management - Lead and manage mine engineers, supervisors, operators, and contractual manpower.
- Develop workforce capability through training and skill enhancement initiatives.
- Ensure effective deployment of manpower and equipment.
Mine Planning & Development - Coordinate with mine planning and geology teams for short-term and long-term mine plans.
- Monitor mine development activities and ensure adherence to approved mining plans.
- Support exploration and reserve estimation activities.
Contractor Management - Manage mining contractors and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
- Monitor contractor performance related to productivity, safety, and quality standards.
Environment Management - Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and mine closure requirements.
- Drive initiatives related to green mining, dust suppression, and sustainability.
Reporting & Documentation - Maintain statutory records, reports, and documentation.
- Prepare MIS reports on production, productivity, safety, and equipment performance.
- Liaise with government authorities, DGMS officials, and other regulatory bodies.

Technical Competencies


Mine Operations Management,DGMS Compliance & Statutory Knowledge,Safety Management Systems,Drilling & Blasting Operations
Qualifications and Experience


Educational Qualification - Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Mining Engineering from a recognized institute.
Mandatory Certification - First Class Mines Manager Certificate of Competency (Restricted/Unrestricted) issued under DGMS regulations.
Experience - 8-15 years of experience in open-cast mining operations.
- Experience in limestone mines will be preferred.
- Proven exposure to drilling, blasting, mine planning, fleet management, and statutory compliance.

Role & responsibilities
Execute routine, preventive, and predictive maintenance of steam/gas turbines and auxiliaries (governing system, lubrication system, vacuum system, etc.).
Monitor and maintain vibration levels, bearing temperatures, and operating parameters within limits.
Assist in planning and execution of major overhauls, turbine roll-over checks, alignment, and balancing.
Troubleshooting & Breakdown Handling
Conduct root cause analysis for turbine faults, trips, or abnormal behavior.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for quick restoration and reduce downtime.
Maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdown logs, history cards, and test reports.
Ensure compliance with safety standards, OEM guidelines, and company SOPs.
Regularly analyze turbine performance indicators and recommend efficiency improvement actions.
Support condition monitoring techniques like vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis.
Identify critical spares and assist in inventory planning.
Raise indent for spares and follow up with procurement.
Train junior engineers and technicians on turbine operation and safety procedures.
Support energy audits, internal inspections, and external inspections (regulatory /OEM).

Functional Competencies
Strong understanding of turbine principles, operation, and maintenance.
Familiarity with rotor dynamics, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics as they apply to turbines,
Proficiency in preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of turbines and auxiliaries.
Capability to prepare job plans, schedules, and resource requirements for turbine overhauls and shutdowns.
Ability to quickly diagnose and troubleshoot turbine-related issues like: High vibrations, Bearing failures, Efficiency drops
Skilled in Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) and implementing corrective actions.
Hands-on experience in disassembly and reassembly of turbines.
Proficient in shaft alignment (dial gauge/laser-based), bearing inspection, and clearance checks.
Working knowledge of vibration analysis, oil analysis, temperature monitoring, and other condition monitoring techniques.

Preferred candidate profile
B.E. / B.Tech Mechanical graduates with 8+ years of experience in Thermal Power Plant.
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.

The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f)
Emotional Stability
- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.
