Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. AEL allows its customers to order a broad range of grocery and household products through its mobile app DMart online grocery shopping and through the website www.dmart.in. Customers can either 1) Self Pick Up: Order online from the app and pick up the order from the nearest DMart Ready Pick-Up point. 2) Home Delivery: Place your order online and get it delivered to home or office at a convenient date &time of choice.


Key Responsibilities
1. GST Compliance & Filings
Manage multi-state GST compliance frameworks across retail channels.
Oversee the timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-8 (e-commerce), and GSTR-9/9C.
Execute 3-way reconciliations across Sales Registers vs. GSTR-1, Purchase Registers vs. GSTR-2B, and ERP ledger balances to optimize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization.
Monitor e-Way bill issuance, e-invoicing workflows, and GST rates.

2. Direct Tax & Regulatory Compliances
Oversee end-to-end Direct Tax, including monthly TDS/TCS deduction, deposit, quarterly return filings (Form 26Q/27Q), and annual Form 16/16A issuance.
Assist in annual Tax Audits (Form 3CD), corporate tax computations, advance tax forecasting, and tax provision reviews in coordination with statutory auditors.

3. Litigation & Dispute Resolution
Draft robust technical replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), audit inquiries, assessment orders, and notices from State/Central GST authorities.
Represent the company before tax officers, appellate authorities, and auditors during assessments, proceedings, and personal hearings.
Partner with external legal counsel, tax advisors, and consultants for high-stakes litigation, appeals, and legal opinions.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Indirect Taxation.
Technical Skills: Strong mastery of GST laws, legal drafting, ITC reconciliation methodologies, TDS/TCS provisions, and advanced Excel. Hands-on exposure to SAP is required.

The Associate Agency Development Manager (ADDM) will be responsible for developing and managing a team of agents to promote and sell life insurance products. This role involves recruiting, training, and mentoring agents to achieve sales targets and enhance their overall performance. The ADDM will work closely with the agents to create effective sales strategies, conduct market research, and maintain customer relationships. Additionally, the position requires collaboration with various departments to ensure alignment of business goals and provide support to agents during the sales process.

- Monitor agents performance and provide constructive feedback and guidance.
- Establish and maintain relationships with clients to drive repeat business and referrals.
- Analyze market trends to identify new business opportunities.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to implement promotional campaigns.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to motivate and inspire a team to meet and exceed sales goals.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Proficiency in customer relationship management (CRM) software.
- Good understanding of life insurance products and the insurance industry.

Tools Required:
- CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM)
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Data analysis tools for market research
- Communication tools (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams)
- Training and development software for agent onboarding and training

This role at Axis Max Life Insurance offers an opportunity to develop your leadership skills while contributing to the growth of the company and the financial well-being of clients.

Job Description Position AVP - KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER Location Head Office Department Corporate Agency and Broking (CABR) Function BroCA - Main Reporting to VP - KAM Band 3A
JOB SUMMARY:
The individual has to operate in a market facing business environment and work to develop and maintain long term high impact & trusted relationship with the key decision makers in the BroCA fraternity. Primary responsibility is to drive the growth and expansion of the channel by identifying business opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, and implementing effective sales strategies.

Candidate should be results-driven, innovative, and able to think strategically. Should be able to develop business expansion plans, cascade and monitor achievement of objectives; Engage with prospect and existing clients in Broking and corporate agency fraternity to meet business volumes and revenues targets within the overall business strategy and objectives.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Sales planning
Scan market potential and overall industry performance, and analyze past performance and input from team to forecast business growth potential
Prepare annual sales plan and propose forecasts for across targeted partners and geographies
Generate ideas for long term growth/ expansion plans in terms of addition to industry segments, key accounts, markets/ geography and team size
2. Sales review
Continuously review sales performance across clients and focus markets/ geographies as against the set targets in the business plan
Provide performance feedback and inputs for course correction to the team to ensure on-target performance
Guide the team to identify/ expand prospect partner base by analyzing and filtering key players in the market
Present the sales performance across metrics to the superior and SLT on a monthly basis, seek input on course corrections
3. Client management
Periodically interact with key client stakeholders at the SLT level for both existing and potential clients to build relationships and identify new business opportunities
Conduct final negotiations with clients on commercial terms, service levels, etc. and guide the team to conduct initial rounds of negotiations
Take up matters with partners that team is not able to close and strike an appropriate compromise to close the deals
4. Internal operations
Discuss and influence cross-functional leaders and teams to seek support for achieving overall sales objectives of the organization
Resolve escalated issues with the customer service teams for speedy resolution of outstanding and complex customer issues
Provide competitor and market intelligence to the product development team for customizing own products in line with competition products and customer needs
Participate in the product and pricing committee to contribute to establishing and determining product pricing
5. Brand building/ Industry recognition
Leverage various industry forums, social media avenues, etc. to ensure communication of First step Product s distinct market positioning in the industry
Participate in various industry forums to exchange ideas, discuss common issues and develop an understanding of latest industry trends, practices and movements
Represent the organization in forums to gain the needed brand recognition for the company
6. Team Management
Participate in selection process to identify the right talent for positions within the sales team
Determine individual training needs and development plans to build expertise and enhance sales skills in the team
Set objectives, conduct reviews and close appraisal processes for the team as per timelines
Measures of Success:
Annualized premium achievement vs targets
Growth in active broker partners
Persistency & business quality
Partner NPS/Relationship scores
Process TAT & issue resolution metrics
Contribution to new initiatives and strategic projects
Key Competencies:
Strategic relationship management
Business & Financial Acumen
Negotiation & Influencing Skills
Leadership & People Development
Stakeholder Management
DESIRED QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE:
Post Graduate degree in Business Management or equivalent.
12-18 years of experience in insurance/broking/financial services, with at least 5 years in senior account management or distribution leadership roles.
Proven track record of handling large partners/accounts with significant revenue contribution.
Strong understanding of the broking ecosystem, open architecture models, and emerging distribution trends.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager


The Associate Agency Development Manager (AADM) is responsible for recruiting, training, and developing a team of insurance agents to achieve sales targets and drive business growth. The AADM will work closely with agents to enhance their skills, ensure compliance with company policies, and support their professional development. The role involves building strong relationships with agents, providing ongoing support and motivation, and monitoring performance metrics to guide agents toward success.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new insurance agents to build a strong agency team.
- Provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to agents, covering product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer relationship management.
- Develop and implement business plans and strategies to achieve sales targets.
- Monitor and evaluate agent performance, providing constructive feedback and support to enhance productivity.
- Foster a positive team culture and motivate agents to reach their full potential.
- Conduct regular meetings and performance reviews with agents to discuss goals, challenges, and opportunities.
- Collaborate with management to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
- Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities to adapt strategies accordingly.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain relationships.
- Leadership and team management capabilities to inspire and guide agents effectively.
- Sales acumen with a proven track record in achieving targets and driving revenue.
- Problem-solving skills to address challenges and find solutions proactively.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services, particularly in life insurance.
- Proficient in using CRM software and other digital tools for tracking performance and managing agent relationships.
- Ability to analyze data and generate reports to inform decision-making.
- Basic knowledge of regulatory requirements in the insurance industry.
- Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Willingness to travel for recruitment and training purposes, as needed.

This position is ideal for individuals looking to make a significant impact in the insurance sector by developing a successful agency team and contributing to the overall growth of Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


The Associate Agency Development Manager will play a crucial role in recruiting, training, and developing a team of insurance agents. The individual will be responsible for driving sales and achieving business targets by fostering a high-performance culture within the agency. This position requires building strong relationships with agents and providing them with the necessary support and tools to succeed in the competitive insurance market. The Associate Agency Development Manager will also focus on implementing marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility and drive customer acquisition.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and develop a team of high-performing insurance agents.
- Provide training and ongoing support to agents to ensure they meet their sales targets.
- Monitor performance metrics and carry out regular performance reviews.
- Implement strategic plans to drive business growth and enhance agency productivity.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with agents and clients.
- Develop and execute local marketing initiatives to promote products and services.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and customer satisfaction.
- Stay updated on industry trends and changes in regulatory policies.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
- Proven experience in sales or insurance, preferably in agency development.
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Ability to motivate and mentor a diverse team.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Adaptability to changing market conditions and organizational needs.

Tools and Technologies:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software.
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis and reporting tools.
- Insurance industry software and platforms.
- Social media and digital marketing tools.

Candidates who possess a passion for sales, a deep understanding of the insurance industry, and a commitment to developing others will thrive in this role.
